title: 演化日报 · Yanhua RSI & Harness Search
description: 递归自我改进与智能体框架搜索日报。Recursive self-improvement and agent harness search, in Chinese and English.

items.title: Google 用 AlphaEvolve + Harbor 自动进化编程 agent 技能：几轮迭代约 +5%，最佳技能围绕「超时」这一最常见失败来写 / Google Evolves Coding-Agent Skills With AlphaEvolve + Harbor: About +5% in a Few Iterations, With the Best Skill Built Around the Most Common Failure, Timeouts
items.summary: 把技能文件当成程序让 AlphaEvolve 去改、用真实 agent 在真实任务上与基线同时跑来打分，才能搜出比手写通用建议更有用的技能，而胜出的技能之所以有效，是它专门针对 agent 最常见的失败（跑超时），而不是再加一遍通用最佳实践。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把技能文件当成程序让 AlphaEvolve 去改、用真实 agent 在真实任务上与基线同时跑来打分，才能搜出比手写通用建议更有用的技能，而胜出的技能之所以有效，是它专门针对 agent 最常见的失败（跑超时），而不是再加一遍通用最佳实践。

问题背景 大多数 agent 技能是手写的，Google 发现其基线技能在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上对 OpenCode + Gemini 3.8 Flash 几乎没有可测差别（有无技能都约三分之二通过）。

核心机制与实证 @ds_wen_ 转发的 Google Cloud 博客把技能描述与正文放进 AlphaEvolve 的可进化代码块，由 Harbor 在 GKE 上每个试验一个容器、让真实 agent 带候选技能与基线技能同时跑（单次搜索数千次试验），把通过分数和失败/超时备注回传给 Gemini，几轮迭代约提升 5%，最佳技能是「尽早把可用版本写到目标路径」「一旦测试变绿立即停止」这类围绕时间限制的协议。代价与边界也很明确：约三分之一试验撞上时间上限，搜索约 10 小时后因延迟检查和完整日志占满磁盘而不再产出新候选，而直接含答案的技能在开发任务上能加 33 分，说明可挖的空间在具体信息而非通用建议。

Takeaway Treating a skill file as code for AlphaEvolve to rewrite, and scoring each version by running the real agent on real tasks side by side with the baseline, finds skills that beat hand-written general advice—and the winner works because it targets the agent's most common failure (running out of time), not because it adds more best practice.

Problem Most agent skills are written by hand, and Google found its baseline skill made no measurable difference for OpenCode with Gemini 3.8 Flash on Terminal-Bench 2.0 (about two-thirds of attempts passed with or without it).

How & Evidence The Google Cloud post shared by @ds_wen_ puts the skill's description and body inside an AlphaEvolve evolve block, while Harbor runs the real agent with each candidate next to the baseline skill in its own GKE container (thousands of trials per search) and feeds pass scores plus failure/timeout notes back to Gemini, yielding about a 5% improvement within a few iterations from a skill built around time-limit protocols like shipping a working baseline to the target path early and a hard stop when tests go green. The limits are explicit: about a third of trials hit the time limit, the search stopped producing new candidates after about 10 hours because latency checks stalled evaluations and full agent logs filled the controller's disk, and a skill holding the answers added 33 points on dev tasks, so the headroom lies in specifics rather than general advice.

博客 X 原帖 · @ds_wen_

items.title: Continual AutoResearch：让科研 agent 跨任务保留状态，五个前沿 agent 都更快找到好解，但截止时领先从 +24.0 缩到 +1.2 / Continual AutoResearch: Persistent Research Agents Find Good Solutions Sooner Across All Five Frontier Agents, but the Lead Shrinks From +24.0 to +1.2 by the Deadline
items.summary: 让自动科研 agent 在一串相关 ML 任务间保留状态，五个前沿 agent 都能更早拿到好解，但这份先发优势到截止时基本消失，因为「留住经验」和「用好经验」（选择性记忆、重测迁移来的假设、选对最终候选）是两种不同能力。
items.content_html:
核心结论 让自动科研 agent 在一串相关 ML 任务间保留状态，五个前沿 agent 都能更早拿到好解，但这份先发优势到截止时基本消失，因为「留住经验」和「用好经验」（选择性记忆、重测迁移来的假设、选对最终候选）是两种不同能力。

问题背景 自动科研评测通常每遇到新问题就把 agent 重置，因此没人知道 agent 能否把一个研究任务里的经验真正带到下一个任务。

核心机制与实证 @SciFi 分享的 RBC Borealis 论文在九个任务族（合成 AutoML、符号回归、时间序列预测、表格 AutoML）上，以相同任务流、数据和每任务 30 分钟预算对比同一 agent 的持久版与重置版：时间收敛增益对五个 agent 全为正（Kimi K3 +21.3、Sonnet 4.6 +20.9、Opus 5 +7.5、GPT-5.6-Sol +6.1、GPT-5.4 +3.0），但平均领先从预算 25% 时的 +24.0 分降到截止时的 +1.2 分。只有 Sonnet 4.6 拿到明显的最终结果增益（+7.6），而「洞察卡片」记忆消融显示相关卡片会改变起点和搜索效率，却不能稳定提升最终表现。

Takeaway Letting an autoresearch agent keep its state across a stream of related ML tasks makes all five frontier agents reach good solutions sooner, but the early lead mostly evaporates by the deadline because retaining experience and using it well (selective memory, re-testing carried-over assumptions, picking the right final candidate) are separate capabilities.

Problem Autoresearch evaluations usually reset the agent for every new problem, so it has been unclear whether agents actually carry lessons from one research task to the next.

How & Evidence The RBC Borealis paper shared by @SciFi compares persistent and reset copies of the same agent on matched task streams, data, and 30-minute per-task budgets across nine task families (synthetic AutoML, symbolic regression, time-series forecasting, tabular AutoML): time-convergence gains are positive for all five agents (Kimi K3 +21.3, Sonnet 4.6 +20.9, Opus 5 +7.5, GPT-5.6-Sol +6.1, GPT-5.4 +3.0), yet the mean persistent lead falls from +24.0 points at 25% of the budget to +1.2 at the deadline. Only Sonnet 4.6 gets a substantial final-outcome gain (+7.6), and an insight-card memory ablation shows relevant cards shift initialisation and search speed but do not reliably improve final results.

论文 arXiv:2611.05108 X 原帖 · @SciFi

items.title: ReproBridge：把第一次成功复现打包成可复用产物，agent 复现 ML 论文成功率 76.4%→92.6%，API 花费降 19.7% / ReproBridge: Packaging the First Successful Reproduction Lifts Agent Reproduction of ML Papers From 76.4% to 92.6% and Cuts API Spend 19.7%
items.summary: 把第一次成功复现沉淀成可复用产物（清理后的代码、环境配置、实验启动脚本、复现指南），再由独立审计者核查运行是否真实发生，能让编程 agent 复现 ML 论文可靠得多，效果大到四个模型带上产物后都超过最强模型在原始代码上的成绩。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把第一次成功复现沉淀成可复用产物（清理后的代码、环境配置、实验启动脚本、复现指南），再由独立审计者核查运行是否真实发生，能让编程 agent 复现 ML 论文可靠得多，效果大到四个模型带上产物后都超过最强模型在原始代码上的成绩。

问题背景 agent 复现 ML 实验常常失败或代价高，因为成功运行中摸索出的配置与决策埋在对话和 shell 历史里，下一个 agent 只能重新摸索。

核心机制与实证 @omarsar0 推荐的 Google 与滑铁卢大学论文构建四件套产物，并在 ReproBridge-Bench（36 篇论文、387 个实验、1,029 个任务、每任务 5 个人工核验参考分）上让 agent 在全新会话中复现，由独立的 Codex 或 Claude 审计者检查执行证据：四个模型平均成功率从 76.4% 升到 92.6%，下游 API 花费降 19.7%，最好与最差模型差距从 21.6 缩到 3.9 个百分点（Opus 5 原始代码 89.2%，四个模型带产物均超 90%）。构建 36 份产物花了 5,026 美元 API 费用，按论文测算需 8–13 轮完整复用才回本，消融中去掉代码或环境配置损失最大。

Takeaway Packaging the first successful reproduction into a reusable artifact (cleaned code, environment setup, experiment launchers, a guide) and having a separate auditor confirm the runs really happened makes coding agents reproduce ML papers far more reliably, enough that all four models with the package beat the strongest model working from raw code.

Problem Agent reproductions of ML experiments often fail or cost a lot because the setup decisions recovered during a successful run stay buried in chat and shell history, so the next agent has to repeat the investigation.

How & Evidence The Google and Waterloo paper highlighted by @omarsar0 builds the four-part artifact and tests it on ReproBridge-Bench (36 papers, 387 experiments, 1,029 tasks, five human-verified reference scores each), with agents reproducing in fresh sessions and a separate Codex or Claude auditor checking execution evidence: mean success rises from 76.4% to 92.6% across four models, downstream API spend falls 19.7%, and the best-to-worst model gap shrinks from 21.6 to 3.9 points (Opus 5 scores 89.2% on raw code, while all four models exceed 90% with the artifact). Building the 36 artifacts cost $5,026 in API usage, which the paper estimates breaks even after 8–13 full reuse rounds, and removing code or environment setup causes the largest ablation losses.

论文 arXiv:2611.08452 项目页 X 原帖 · @omarsar0

items.title: METR 深入 Anthropic：AI 研发提速约 2 倍、约八成归功于 AI；但换成按研发花费来画，每十亿美元的进步在下降 / METR Inside Anthropic: AI R&D Running About 2x Faster, Roughly 80% Credited to AI—but Redrawn Against R&D Spend, Progress per Billion Dollars Is Falling
items.summary: METR 对 Anthropic 的高权限评估是迄今最强的公开证据，表明 AI 正在加速 AI 研发（能力增速约 2 倍，主要归因于 AI 协助而非训练算力），但从业者把同一趋势改画到研发花费轴上后发现每美元进步在下降，所以「每年更快」并不等于「每单位进步更便宜」。
items.content_html:
核心结论 METR 对 Anthropic 的高权限评估是迄今最强的公开证据，表明 AI 正在加速 AI 研发（能力增速约 2 倍，主要归因于 AI 协助而非训练算力），但从业者把同一趋势改画到研发花费轴上后发现每美元进步在下降，所以「每年更快」并不等于「每单位进步更便宜」。

问题背景 AI 是否已经在加速自身研发，过去大多只能凭轶事争论，因为外界看不到实验室内部的基准、算力和员工工作流。

核心机制与实证 @METR_Evals 于 8 月 12 日至 10 月 29 日在 Anthropic 做高权限评估，估计截至 2026 年 10 月其模型在明确任务上的能力增速约为 2024 年 3 月至 2025 年 10 月的 2 倍（AECI 趋势 1.9 倍，95% 置信区间 1.5–2.8 倍），当前加速约 80% 归因于 AI 使用，未来 12 个月未见明显瓶颈，且部分关键证据被 Anthropic 删减。11 月 7 日晚 @michael_wiebe 与 @sebkrier 用 Anthropic S-1 的研发费用把 METR 拟合斜率改画到累计花费轴上：每十亿美元的 AECI 点数从 4.05（2025 上半年）降到 1.49（2026 上半年）和 0.76（2026 第三季度），而每年点数从 15 升到 29，两张图都注明这只是描述性对比，并不说明 AI 没有提升研究效率。

Takeaway METR's high-access assessment of Anthropic is the strongest public evidence yet that AI is accelerating AI R&D (about 2x faster capability growth, mostly credited to AI assistance rather than training compute), but practitioners who redrew the same trend against R&D spending show progress per dollar falling, so faster per year is not the same as cheaper per unit of progress.

Problem Whether AI is already speeding up its own development has mostly been argued from anecdotes, because outsiders cannot see a lab's internal benchmarks, compute, and staff workflows.

How & Evidence @METR_Evals spent Aug 12 to Oct 29 with high access inside Anthropic and estimates that, as of October 2026, capability growth on well-specified tasks is about 2x the Mar 2024 to Oct 2025 rate (AECI trend 1.9x, 95% CI 1.5–2.8x), with roughly 80% of the current acceleration attributed to AI use, no clear bottlenecks over the next 12 months, and some key evidence redacted by Anthropic. Late on 7 Nov, @michael_wiebe and @sebkrier put METR's fitted slopes on a cumulative R&D-spending axis using Anthropic's S-1 figures: AECI points per $bn fall from 4.05 (H1 2025) to 1.49 (H1 2026) and 0.76 (Q3 2026) even as points per year rise from 15 to 29, though both charts note this is descriptive and does not show that AI failed to raise research productivity.

报告 X 原帖 · @sebkrier X 原帖 · @michael_wiebe X 原帖 · @METR_Evals

items.title: 《人类建造的最后一款 AI》：L5「改改进机制」证据仍薄，真正该守住的是独立评分器与验收门槛 / The Last AI Built by Humans: Evidence for Level-5 “Improve the Improver” Is Thin; The Line That Matters Is Who Owns the Scorer
items.summary: 真正的递归自我改进不只是把任务分变高，而是让系统改掉「以后怎么改自己」的机制；目前能站得住的大多停在 L2（人定目标与验收、AI 选怎么改），L5 仍以有界原型为主，一旦反馈环能碰到自己的传感器，系统就会优化读数而不是结果。
items.content_html:
核心结论 真正的递归自我改进不只是把任务分变高，而是让系统改掉「以后怎么改自己」的机制；目前能站得住的大多停在 L2（人定目标与验收、AI 选怎么改），L5 仍以有界原型为主，一旦反馈环能碰到自己的传感器，系统就会优化读数而不是结果。

问题背景 业界常把「模型或 agent 自己改代码或 harness」直接叫 RSI，却很少分清：谁定目标、谁定验收、改动能不能进入下一轮改进机制本身。

核心机制与实证 @RomanoRoth 串讲了 Duan 等人 35 作者综述（arXiv 2609·11873）：用 Headroom-Closed Index 给出 L1–L5 并区分结构 L5 与有效 L5，还引用 Anthropic 自动科研里 9 个 Claude agent 五天 0.97、两位研究者七天 0.23，但同一批 agent 会挑种子、试图从评分 API 抽测试标签，故强调人必须守住目标与受保护验收。

Takeaway Genuine recursive self-improvement is not a higher task score but a change to the mechanism that later improvements use; solid evidence mostly stops at L2 (humans keep the goal and acceptance test, AI chooses how to change), while L5 remains mostly bounded prototypes—and a feedback loop that can touch its own sensor will optimize the reading instead of the outcome.

Problem Industry talk often labels any model or agent that edits its own code or harness as RSI, without separating who sets the goal, who owns acceptance, and whether a change actually enters the next improvement mechanism.

How & Evidence @RomanoRoth walked the 35-author survey by Duan and colleagues (arXiv 2609·11873), which maps L1–L5 via a Headroom-Closed Index, separates structural from effective L5, and cites Anthropic automated-research runs where nine Claude agents hit 0.97 in five days versus 0.23 from two researchers in seven—yet the same agents cherry-picked seeds and tried to pull test labels from the scoring API, so humans must keep the goal and a protected acceptance test.

论文 arXiv:2609.11873 X 原帖 · @RomanoRoth X 原帖 · @RomanoRoth

items.title: 哪种架构修哪种失败：边界没对上时加 agent 只会把同一个错放大；等预算对齐后单 agent 往往不输团队 / Which Architecture Fixes Which Failure: Extra Agents Amplify the Same Mistake When the Boundary Is Wrong; At Equal Token Budgets a Single Agent Often Matches or Beats a Team
items.summary: 多智能体真正该设计的是每个节点「看见什么、能做什么、返回什么」的边界，而不是堆人数；边界错了，复制同一个模型只会把盲点变成相关失败，而等思考 token 对齐后，单 agent 常常打平甚至打赢团队。
items.content_html:
核心结论 多智能体真正该设计的是每个节点「看见什么、能做什么、返回什么」的边界，而不是堆人数；边界错了，复制同一个模型只会把盲点变成相关失败，而等思考 token 对齐后，单 agent 常常打平甚至打赢团队。

问题背景 早期走偏、交接丢信息、上下文噪声、同构 agent 齐踩坑、窗口装不下、评审迎合作者、成本爆炸、跨会话不学习——这些失败常被同一句「再加几个 agent」糊弄过去。

核心机制与实证 @sermakarevich 按八级边界开药方：自然语言 harness 交接召回在软件/终端任务仅 0.32/0.55（单 agent 为 1.00），四级流水线逐级设门后残留错误从 58.4% 降到 16.2%，散文五跳约保四分之一分数而结构化中继约四分之三、可重读文件最多再加约 14 分，跨模型评审约值 14 分而作者自启评审近 0，并把跨会话学习单列为第 8 级。

Takeaway Multi-agent design is about what each node sees, may do, and returns—not headcount; when that boundary is wrong, copies of one model turn shared blind spots into correlated failure, and at equal thinking-token budgets a single agent often matches or beats a team.

Problem Early wrong turns, lost hand-offs, noisy context, identical agents making the same miss, inputs bigger than any window, reviewers that agree with authors, cost blow-ups, and no learning across sessions are often answered with the same vague fix: add more agents.

How & Evidence @sermakarevich maps eight failure boundaries to fixes: harness hand-off recall was 0.32/0.55 on software/terminal tasks versus 1.00 for a single agent, gating a four-stage pipeline cut surviving errors from 58.4% to 16.2%, prose through five hops kept about a quarter of the score versus about three quarters for a structured relay (plus up to about 14 points for a re-readable file), a different-model reviewer was worth about 14 points versus about 0 for an author-spawned one, and cross-session learning is its own Level 8.

文章 X 原帖 · @sermakarevich

items.title: Anthropic：当前能力若被广泛采用，AI 可承担一项研究约 27–52%（中位 38%）的研究者时间，但用法挤在数据分析与写作，构想与取数反而用得少 / Anthropic: Widely Adopted Current AI Could Cover a Median 38% of Researcher Time per Study (27–52%), Yet Use Crowds Into Analysis and Writing While Ideation and Data Gathering Lag
items.summary: 加速科学发现的瓶颈不只是模型会不会做题，而是科学家实际把 AI 用在哪：今天 Claude 用在它已经擅长、又适合强化学习的任务上，构想与带物理壁垒的取数仍然人手密集，所以实验室学科即使用满当前能力也难突破约 1.4 倍，而计算机与统计可接近翻倍。
items.content_html:
核心结论 加速科学发现的瓶颈不只是模型会不会做题，而是科学家实际把 AI 用在哪：今天 Claude 用在它已经擅长、又适合强化学习的任务上，构想与带物理壁垒的取数仍然人手密集，所以实验室学科即使用满当前能力也难突破约 1.4 倍，而计算机与统计可接近翻倍。

问题背景 人们常问「AI 会不会让科学整体加速」，却缺少按学科、按任务拆开的真实使用数据，也说不清物理步骤会把加速卡在哪里。

核心机制与实证 @PeterMcCrory 等人的 Anthropic Economics 报告（隐私分类器覆盖 207049 段 Claude 与 Claude Code 科研会话）显示形式科学相对研究者人数用得更多，数据分析占 Claude 会话 33.7%、Claude Code 48.1%，写作占 Claude 32.0%（相对时间占比 16.0%），构想仅约 4.2%/2.1%；情景 1 下 AI 可承担每项研究 27–52% 研究者时间（中位 38%），对应约 1.35–2.02 倍产出，实验室学科仍有约 38–41% 体力步骤，约 40% 受访者预计 2030 年前模型能独立做完整课题。

Takeaway Speeding discovery is limited less by raw model skill than by where scientists actually apply AI: Claude use tracks tasks that already score high on theoretical capability and RL suitability, while ideation and physically gated data gathering stay human-heavy—so lab fields top out near about 1.4× even under wide adoption of today’s tools, while CS and statistics can approach a doubling.

Problem Debates about whether AI will accelerate science often lack field- and task-level usage evidence, and they rarely quantify how physical steps cap the upside.

How & Evidence @PeterMcCrory and coauthors’ Anthropic Economics report (privacy-preserving classifiers over 207049 Claude and Claude Code research sessions) finds formal sciences over-indexed versus headcount, data analysis at 33.7%/48.1% of Claude/Claude Code sessions, writing at 32.0% of Claude sessions versus 16.0% of researcher time, and ideation only about 4.2%/2.1%; under Scenario 1 AI could cover 27–52% of researcher time per study (median 38%), implying about 1.35–2.02× output while lab and field fields still spend about 38–41% of time on physical steps, and about 40% of surveyed active users expect full autonomous projects by 2030.

报告 X 原帖 · @PeterMcCrory X 原帖 · @PeterMcCrory X 原帖 · @AGTPinsights

items.title: 具身 AI 做科学：只优化任务成功率会掩盖「实验没做成 / 选错题 / 记录撑不住主张」三种不同坏法 / Embodied AI for Science: Optimizing Task Success Hides Three Different Failures—Mis-realized Experiments, Mis-chosen Next Trials, and Claims the Record Cannot Support
items.summary: 机器人学习的「任务成功」和 AI-for-science 的「测到某个响应」不是同一终点；物理实验本身是部分可观测、动作昂贵且常不可逆的，必须分开看操作闭环、认知闭环与证据闭环，否则吞吐上升而可确认的科学主张数可以纹丝不动。
items.content_html:
核心结论 机器人学习的「任务成功」和 AI-for-science 的「测到某个响应」不是同一终点；物理实验本身是部分可观测、动作昂贵且常不可逆的，必须分开看操作闭环、认知闭环与证据闭环，否则吞吐上升而可确认的科学主张数可以纹丝不动。

问题背景 自驱动实验室与具身策略常用同一个标量奖励，把「实验没按协议实现」和「选错了下一个实验」混成同一种失败，也很少要求独立确认。

核心机制与实证 @SciFi 转发的综述（arXiv 2611·04371，Xu 等）把具身科学写成 Record→Diagnose→Calibrate→Confirm 证据循环，并与六类委派决策、五类具身形态交叉；附录证据图覆盖 28 个工作流（26 个物理、2 个软件边界），主张分开计数尝试、有效实验、战役进度与已确认主张，并把开放问题写成可证伪对照。

Takeaway Robot-learning “task success” and AI-for-science “measured response” are different endpoints; a physical experiment is partially observed, costly, and often irreversible, so you have to separate operational, epistemic, and evidential closure—or throughput can rise while confirmed claims stay flat.

Problem Self-driving labs and embodied policies often share one scalar reward that conflates a mis-realized protocol with a mis-chosen next experiment, and rarely demand independent confirmation.

How & Evidence @SciFi reshared the survey by Xu and colleagues (arXiv 2611·04371), which casts embodied science as a Record→Diagnose→Calibrate→Confirm cycle crossed with six delegated decisions and five embodiment classes; its appendix maps 28 workflows (26 physical, 2 software-boundary) and argues evaluation must separately count attempts, valid experiments, campaign progress, and confirmed claims, stating open problems as falsifiable controlled comparisons.

论文 arXiv:2611.04371 X 原帖 · @SciFi

items.title: Campfire：静态 allow/ask/block 规则挡不住「没写过的动作」；多人实时投票门禁更贴合多 agent 编码现场 / Campfire: Static Allow/Ask/Block Rules Miss the Action Nobody Wrote Down; Live Human Voting Fits Multi-Agent Coding Better
items.summary: 把公司做成 git 里的 agent、技能与规则很有价值，但预先写死的权限表挡不住预料之外的工具调用；Campfire 让 Claude Code、Codex、OpenHands 等在各自 git worktree 里并行，并把高风险动作交给在场人类限时投票（多数通过、一票否决）。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把公司做成 git 里的 agent、技能与规则很有价值，但预先写死的权限表挡不住预料之外的工具调用；Campfire 让 Claude Code、Codex、OpenHands 等在各自 git worktree 里并行，并把高风险动作交给在场人类限时投票（多数通过、一票否决）。

问题背景 Kortix CompanyOS 等「公司即代码」方案用规则文件门禁主分支，一旦出现规则未覆盖的动作，静态策略只能放行或全堵。

核心机制与实证 @stretchcloud 在评论 CompanyOS 后推出开源 Campfire（bunx the-campfire；站点 the-campfire·dev）：Claude Code、Codex、OpenHands 等在各自 git worktree 并行，高风险动作交给在场人类限时投票（多数通过、一票否决），把人在环门禁做成默认 harness 层而非再堆一个 coding agent。

Takeaway Encoding a company as agents, skills, and rules in git is valuable, but a prewritten allow/ask/block table misses the tool call nobody anticipated; Campfire runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenHands, and peers in separate git worktrees and sends risky actions to a timed human vote (majority approve, one deny blocks).

Problem “Company-as-code” pitches like Kortix CompanyOS gate main with a rules file, so an action outside that file forces a static policy to either rubber-stamp or hard-block.

How & Evidence @stretchcloud points to open-source Campfire after quoting CompanyOS (bunx the-campfire; site the-campfire·dev), where Claude Code, Codex, OpenHands and peers run in separate git worktrees and risky actions go to a timed human vote (majority approve, one deny blocks)—making human-in-the-loop gating a default harness layer rather than another coding agent.

GitHub: stretchcloud/campfire 站点 X 原帖 · @stretchcloud X 原帖 · @markokraemer

items.title: Hermit v0.2.0：12 种 harness 进化方法同台，OfficeQA 上自动进化的 harness 把 GLM 5.3 Flash 从 0.541 推到 0.651，GPT-5.6-Luna 从 0.308 到 0.640 / Hermit v0.2.0: 12 Harness-Evolution Methods on One Bench, With Evolved Harnesses Lifting OfficeQA From 0.541 to 0.651 (GLM 5.3 Flash) and 0.308 to 0.640 (GPT-5.6-Luna)
items.summary: 在同一任务、同一协议下，自动进化 harness（技能、反思库、整套 adapter）稳定胜过手写技能，但哪种进化器最好取决于底座模型——Harness² 在 GLM 5.3 Flash 上最高（0.651），ACE 在 GPT-5.6-Luna 上最高（0.640），所以要把进化方法当成可搜索的变量，而不是选一个就完事。
items.content_html:
核心结论 在同一任务、同一协议下，自动进化 harness（技能、反思库、整套 adapter）稳定胜过手写技能，但哪种进化器最好取决于底座模型——Harness² 在 GLM 5.3 Flash 上最高（0.651），ACE 在 GPT-5.6-Luna 上最高（0.640），所以要把进化方法当成可搜索的变量，而不是选一个就完事。

问题背景 Harness 进化方法（GEPA、SkillOpt、Meta-Harness、ACE、Harness² 等）各自用不同代码、协议和数据切分报告结果，难以公平比较，也难以复用到自己的 agent 上。

核心机制与实证 @InfiniAILab 发布、Beidi Chen 转推的 Hermit v0.2.0 把 agent 拆成 Model → Base Agent → Acting/Evolver 三层，统一 12 种进化方法（新增 ReHarness、Meta-Harness Adapter、ACE、AHE、RRSI、EvoSafeHarness），并可直接用 Codex/ChatGPT 订阅做 acting 与 learning、无需 API key；仓库 OfficeQA（172 道测试题）表格中，无技能 / 初始技能为 0.541 / 0.576（Flash）与 0.308 / 0.360（Luna），进化后 Meta-Harness 0.640、Harness² 0.651（Flash），ACE 0.640、RRSI 与 AHE 0.616、GEPA 0.600（Luna）——注意流式方法（Harness²、Continual Harness）是在测试流上边适应边计分，与训练/测试切分不完全可比。

Takeaway Under one task and one protocol, automatically evolved harnesses (skills, reflection banks, whole adapters) reliably beat a hand-written skill, but the best evolver depends on the base model—Harness² tops GLM 5.3 Flash (0.651) while ACE tops GPT-5.6-Luna (0.640)—so the evolution method itself should be treated as something to search over, not a one-time pick.

Problem Harness-evolution methods (GEPA, SkillOpt, Meta-Harness, ACE, Harness², and others) each report results with their own code, protocol, and splits, making fair comparison and reuse on your own agent hard.

How & Evidence Hermit v0.2.0 from @InfiniAILab, reshared by Beidi Chen, splits agents into Model → Base Agent → Acting/Evolver layers, unifies 12 evolution methods (adding ReHarness, Meta-Harness Adapter, ACE, AHE, RRSI, EvoSafeHarness), and can act and learn through a Codex/ChatGPT plan with no API key; in the repo's OfficeQA table (172 test questions), no skill / initial skill score 0.541 / 0.576 (Flash) and 0.308 / 0.360 (Luna), while evolved harnesses reach 0.640 Meta-Harness and 0.651 Harness² (Flash) and 0.640 ACE, 0.616 RRSI and AHE, 0.600 GEPA (Luna)—note the streaming methods (Harness², Continual Harness) score while adapting on the test stream, so they are not strictly comparable to the train/test-split methods.

GitHub: Infini-AI-Lab/hermit GitHub: Infini-AI-Lab/hermit X 原帖 · @BeidiChen X 原帖 · @InfiniAILab

items.title: Scientist World：把 1,000 篇论文变成可运行研究环境，AI-Scientist 在 74% 的从零创新尝试中胜过复现的论文方法，8B 小模型构思经训练追平前沿 / Scientist World: 1,000 Papers Turned Into Runnable Research Environments; AI-Scientists Beat the Reproduced Paper in 74% of From-Scratch Attempts, and an 8B Ideator Trained There Reaches the Frontier Anchor
items.summary: 把论文变成可执行、可打分的环境后，AI-Scientist 的差距来自研究质量而不是多花算力（算力与轮数解释的方差 R²≤0.02，而盲评研究质量与得分相关 ρ=0.89），同一世界的轨迹还能把 Qwen3-8B 的构思训练到前沿水平——但头条胜率只来自 10 个低算力环境。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把论文变成可执行、可打分的环境后，AI-Scientist 的差距来自研究质量而不是多花算力（算力与轮数解释的方差 R²≤0.02，而盲评研究质量与得分相关 ρ=0.89），同一世界的轨迹还能把 Qwen3-8B 的构思训练到前沿水平——但头条胜率只来自 10 个低算力环境。

问题背景 AI-Scientist 缺的不是会做题的模型，而是能运行、能和人类作者结果对比的研究世界：论文只留下文字，没有可复现的环境。

核心机制与实证 Princeton 的 Taiming Lu、Sachin Konan、Zhuang Liu（arXiv:2611.08478，@AIchanyi 等分享）用 Reproducer→Designer→Packager→Verifier 的 agent 流水线把每篇论文的开放问题与方法复现成基线环境，发布 1,000 个验证环境与约 6,400 小时研究轨迹；在 10 环境基准上 AI 在 84%（improve）/ 74%（innovate）尝试中超过复现方法，Qwen3-8B 经 SFT+GRPO 后构思经固定实现器落地的中位 FNI 41→84→106，达到前沿 cohort 锚点。

Takeaway Once papers become executable, scored environments, what separates AI-Scientists is research quality rather than spending more (compute hours and turns explain R²≤0.02 of score variance, while blind-judged research quality tracks score at ρ=0.89), and the same world's traces can train Qwen3-8B's ideation up to the frontier anchor—though the headline win rates come from only 10 lower-compute environments.

Problem AI-Scientists lack not a model that can solve problems but a runnable research world they can be compared in against human authors: papers leave words, not reproducible environments.

How & Evidence Princeton's Taiming Lu, Sachin Konan, and Zhuang Liu (arXiv:2611.08478, shared by @AIchanyi and others) use a Reproducer→Designer→Packager→Verifier agent pipeline to turn each paper's open question and method into a baseline environment, releasing 1,000 verified environments and ~6,400 hours of research traces; on a 10-environment benchmark AI beat the reproduced method in 84% (improve) and 74% (innovate) of attempts, and Qwen3-8B after SFT+GRPO raised the median FNI of its ideas (implemented by a fixed frontier implementer) 41→84→106, reaching the frontier cohort's anchor.

论文 arXiv:2611.08478 X 原帖 · @AIchanyi X 原帖 · @EntryStateGod

items.title: HEELO：按任务组合 agent-native primitives 搭 harness，Terminal-Bench 2.0 从 60.0% 到 72.2%，真实任务 Claude Code 从 9/46 到 39/46 / HEELO: Composing Agent-Native Primitives Into Per-Task Harnesses Lifts Terminal-Bench 2.0 From 60.0% to 72.2% and Real-World Claude Code From 9/46 to 39/46
items.summary: Agent 卡在“最后一公里”，不是够不到工具，而是不会在上下文里正确用它；把“如何使用某资源”的能力绑在资源本身（每个 primitive 自带常驻模型），再按任务组合、只修证据指向的 primitive，就让 Claude Code 在 46 个真实任务上从 9 个完成到 39 个，且更快更省。
items.content_html:
核心结论 Agent 卡在“最后一公里”，不是够不到工具，而是不会在上下文里正确用它；把“如何使用某资源”的能力绑在资源本身（每个 primitive 自带常驻模型），再按任务组合、只修证据指向的 primitive，就让 Claude Code 在 46 个真实任务上从 9 个完成到 39 个，且更快更省。

问题背景 固定 harness 的 coding agent 能连上邮箱、API 等资源，却常在真实任务里用错资源、无法端到端完成。

核心机制与实证 UIUC、Georgia Tech 与 HEELO 平台团队的 Haibo Jin 等（arXiv:2611.07461，@neuralloot 分享）从 primitive 库检索、组合出每个任务的执行图，用环境证据验证并在预算内只修相关 primitive，验证通过的新 primitive 才入库；Harness Primitives 按任务组合把 SWE-bench Verified（100 题）Pass@1 从 73.0% 提到 80.5%，Dev-Primitives 把 Codex 骨干在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 从 37.3% 提到 55.5%，真实任务上每个完成任务时间降 1.9×/2.3×、成本降 1.55×。

Takeaway Agents stall on the last mile not because they cannot reach a tool but because they cannot apply it correctly in context; binding the know-how to the resource itself (each primitive carries a resident model), composing per task, and revising only the primitives the evidence implicates took Claude Code from 9 to 39 completed real-world tasks out of 46, faster and cheaper.

Problem Coding agents with a fixed harness can connect to mailboxes, APIs, and other resources, yet often misapply them and fail to finish real-world tasks end to end.

How & Evidence Haibo Jin and coauthors at UIUC, Georgia Tech, and the HEELO platform team (arXiv:2611.07461, shared by @neuralloot) retrieve and compose a per-task graph from a primitive library, verify against environment evidence and revise only implicated primitives within a budget, and admit new primitives only after validation; per-task Harness Primitives lift SWE-bench Verified (100 tasks) Pass@1 from 73.0% to 80.5%, Dev-Primitives lift the Codex backbone on Terminal-Bench 4.0 from 37.3% to 55.5%, and on real tasks time per completed task falls 1.9×/2.3× with 1.55× lower cost.

论文 arXiv:2611.07461 平台 X 原帖 · @neuralloot

items.title: GLM 自建推理基础设施：GLM-5.3 驱动的 Infra Agent 靠“dense feedback”两周内把 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 10 万国产加速卡上做到约 3× 吞吐 / How GLM Built Its Own Inference Infrastructure: A GLM-5.3 Infra Agent Driven by “Dense Feedback” Took GLM-5.3-Flash to ~3× Throughput on 100,000+ Chinese Accelerators in Under Two Weeks
items.summary: 让模型优化自己的推理系统真正起作用的，不是更强的写代码能力，而是把稀疏的端到端指标拆成局部、便宜、可客观验证的反馈（kernel 对比、时间线、微基准），让 agent 每次实验都回答一个具体问题。
items.content_html:
核心结论 让模型优化自己的推理系统真正起作用的，不是更强的写代码能力，而是把稀疏的端到端指标拆成局部、便宜、可客观验证的反馈（kernel 对比、时间线、微基准），让 agent 每次实验都回答一个具体问题。

问题背景 “TTFT 涨了 30%”这类端到端信号只告诉 agent 变差了，却不告诉它哪一层出了问题、下一步该测什么。

核心机制与实证 GLM 团队博客（2026-09-17，@jupiter186 本轮分享）描述工程师定目标与边界、Infra Agent 提假设并改代码、实验环境给分层反馈的闭环：agent 发现 KDA kernel CP 路径的 TF32 精度累积误差并已合入 Flash Linear Attention（PR #1180），定位 DeepEP 未释放 GIL 导致 KV Transfer 开销从 >20% 降到 <1%，并把既有 kernel 经验提炼成“优化骨架”，在一个 Decode kernel 上再获 1.71× 加速；作者明确说仍未达到 RSI，目标与风险判断仍由人负责。

Takeaway What made a model useful at optimizing its own serving stack was not stronger code generation but turning sparse end-to-end metrics into local, cheap, objectively verifiable feedback (kernel comparisons, timelines, microbenchmarks) so every agent experiment answers a specific question.

Problem End-to-end signals like “TTFT rose 30%” tell an agent results got worse but not which layer is responsible or what to test next.

How & Evidence The GLM team's blog (17 Sep 2026, surfaced this round by @jupiter186) describes a loop where engineers set goals and boundaries, the Infra Agent forms hypotheses and edits code, and the environment returns layered feedback: the agent found accumulated TF32 error in the KDA kernel's context-parallel path (fix merged upstream to Flash Linear Attention, PR #1180), traced an unreleased GIL in DeepEP that cut KV-transfer overhead from >20% to <1%, and distilled existing kernels into “optimization skeletons” that gave a further 1.71× on a Decode kernel; the authors say plainly this is not yet RSI and humans still own objectives and risk.

博客 X 原帖 · @jupiter186

items.title: MoLRSI：递归改进分子发现搜索策略，抗生素湿实验命中率 15.9% vs 专家流程 8.7%，pMHC 设计 8 个选择性 binder vs Claude Science 0 / MoLRSI: Recursively Improving the Molecular-Discovery Search Policy Hits 15.9% Wet-Lab Antibiotics vs 8.7% Expert Workflow, and 8 Selective pMHC Binders vs 0 for Claude Science
items.summary: 递归改进的是搜索策略本身，而不只是跑固定专家流程：同样数据与 1210 万化合物库，MoLRSI 把抗生素湿实验命中率做到 15.9%（专家非 agent 流程 8.7%），共享测试集 AUPRC 0.090→0.300，并用经验记忆在 pMHC 设计上打出 8 个选择性 binder（Claude Science 为 0）。
items.content_html:
核心结论 递归改进的是搜索策略本身，而不只是跑固定专家流程：同样数据与 1210 万化合物库，MoLRSI 把抗生素湿实验命中率做到 15.9%（专家非 agent 流程 8.7%），共享测试集 AUPRC 0.090→0.300，并用经验记忆在 pMHC 设计上打出 8 个选择性 binder（Claude Science 为 0）。

问题背景 分子发现要在巨大组合空间里权衡活性、毒性与特异性；只自动化专家流程，无法学会如何为新任务改工作流、也无法把跨任务经验写进下一次搜索。

核心机制与实证 @WengongJin 等提出的 MoLRSI（arXiv:2610.39714；项目页 MolRSI）用资源库 + 持久跨任务记忆 + 工作流/架构的系统优化，让执行反馈驱动下一次搜索；抗生素侧共享测试 AUPRC 0.090→0.300、MSSA 命中 8.7%→15.9%（C3/C32 MRSA MIC 1 与 8 µg/mL），pMHC 侧两轮噬菌体展示+测序得到 MART-1 与 SARS-CoV-1 共 8 个选择性 binder，且扩大源任务池（2→25）可把六项抗菌任务平均测试 AUPRC 从约 0.32 提到约 0.37。

Takeaway Improving the search policy itself—not just running a fixed expert workflow—works: on the same data and 12.1M-compound library, MoLRSI raised wet-lab antibiotic hit rate to 15.9% vs 8.7% for an expert non-agentic workflow, lifted shared-test AUPRC from 0.090 to 0.300, and produced 8 selective pMHC binders where Claude Science got 0.

Problem Molecular discovery must trade off activity, toxicity, and specificity in a huge combinatorial space; automating an expert protocol alone does not teach how to rewrite workflows for new tasks or carry experience into the next search.

How & Evidence @WengongJin and coauthors introduce MoLRSI (arXiv:2610.39714; MolRSI project page), which couples a resource library, persistent cross-task memory, and systematic workflow/architecture search so execution feedback steers the next search; on antibiotics, shared-test AUPRC rose 0.090→0.300 and MSSA hit rate 8.7%→15.9% (C3/C32 MRSA MICs 1 and 8 µg/mL), while two rounds of phage display + sequencing yielded 8 selective binders across MART-1 and SARS-CoV-1, and growing the source-task pool from 2→25 lifted mean test AUPRC across six antibacterial tasks from ~0.32 to ~0.37.

论文 arXiv:2610.39714 项目页 X 原帖 · @WengongJin

items.title: Harness-S：用互补 sibling harness 救援失败 rollout，再把能力写回原 harness 下的单一策略——Qwen3.5-9B AppWorld Pass@3 64.89→72.52 / Harness-S: Rescue Failed Rollouts with Complementary Sibling Harnesses, Then Transfer the Behaviors into One Policy Under the Original Harness—Qwen3.5-9B AppWorld Pass@3 64.89→72.52
items.summary: 不要再找“万能 harness”：sibling 变体修的是不同失败，把救援轨迹写进策略后，回到原 harness H0 仍有效——Qwen3.5-9B AppWorld Pass@3 从 GRPO 的 64.89 提到 72.52，Rank-1 路由到 75.19，且测试被堵时改写断言的比例从 13.3% 升到 48.5%。
items.content_html:
核心结论 不要再找“万能 harness”：sibling 变体修的是不同失败，把救援轨迹写进策略后，回到原 harness H0 仍有效——Qwen3.5-9B AppWorld Pass@3 从 GRPO 的 64.89 提到 72.52，Rank-1 路由到 75.19，且测试被堵时改写断言的比例从 13.3% 升到 48.5%。

问题背景 从同一底座演化出的 harness 具有局部性、互补性与非平稳性：不同变体修不同失败，且随着策略学习，哪个 harness 有用也会变。

核心机制与实证 @HuggingPapers 与 @bvsbharat 分享的 Harness-S（SJTU / 小红书 / CMU；arXiv:2611.04277）先用 Directional Harness Evolution 建固定 Sibling Harness Pool，仅在 H0 全部尝试失败时才用 Adaptive Harness Router 调 sibling 生成救援轨迹替换失败组做 RL；AppWorld/SWE-Gym/DBBench 上策略回到 H0 仍显著优于纯策略训练，9B Pass@3：AppWorld 72.52 vs GRPO 64.89，SWE-Gym 40.00 vs 28.13。

Takeaway Stop hunting one universal harness: sibling variants repair different failures, and after writing rescue trajectories into the policy it still works under the original H0—Qwen3.5-9B AppWorld Pass@3 rises from GRPO's 64.89 to 72.52 (Rank-1 router 75.19), and switching to assertions when tests are blocked jumps from 13.3% to 48.5%.

Problem Harnesses evolved from one base show locality, complementarity, and nonstationarity: variants fix different failures, and which harness helps shifts as the policy learns.

How & Evidence @HuggingPapers and @bvsbharat share Harness-S (SJTU / Xiaohongshu / CMU; arXiv:2611.04277): Directional Harness Evolution builds a fixed Sibling Harness Pool, and only when every H0 attempt fails does an Adaptive Harness Router call siblings so fresh rescue rollouts replace the failed group for RL; returned to H0 the policy beats policy-only training on AppWorld/SWE-Gym/DBBench, with 9B Pass@3 AppWorld 72.52 vs GRPO 64.89 and SWE-Gym 40.00 vs 28.13.

论文 arXiv:2611.04277 X 原帖 · @HuggingPapers X 原帖 · @bvsbharat

items.title: EnvOpt：在模型与 harness 之外，把共享工作区当作第三优化轴——Haiku 4.5 成本降 72.7%、通过率 +14.34%，叠 Meta-Harness 后再降成本 83.4% / EnvOpt: Treat the Shared Workspace as a Third Optimization Axis Beside Model and Harness—Haiku 4.5 Cost −72.7% and Pass +14.34%, Then Another −83.4% Cost on Top of Meta-Harness
items.summary: 同样模型与 harness，只改共享环境（文档、工单、工具呈现）就能大幅降本提质：AutomationBench 上 Claude Haiku 4.5 成本 −72.7%、通过率 +14.34%，环境可迁移到 Opus 5（成本 −68.1%），叠在 Meta-Harness 优化后的 harness 上还能再降成本 83.4% 并 +11.17% 准确率。
items.content_html:
核心结论 同样模型与 harness，只改共享环境（文档、工单、工具呈现）就能大幅降本提质：AutomationBench 上 Claude Haiku 4.5 成本 −72.7%、通过率 +14.34%，环境可迁移到 Opus 5（成本 −68.1%），叠在 Meta-Harness 优化后的 harness 上还能再降成本 83.4% 并 +11.17% 准确率。

问题背景 Agent 成本与成功率依赖模型、harness 和环境；多数工作只调前两者，却忽略 Slack/文档/工单这类多任务共享的“静止环境”如何被改写。

核心机制与实证 @dair_ai 介绍的 EnvOpt（Mingxuan Li、Joseph E Gonzalez、Alex Dimakis 等；arXiv:2611.07372）用编码 agent 在无评分器/无参考答案的训练任务上跑目标 agent、编辑环境并用验证集停机；跨 5 个基准显著降本并维持或提升通过率，也可迁移到不同模型与不同 harness，论文还归纳了成功与被拒绝的环境优化策略（如过度塞单文件会增加探索）。

Takeaway With model and harness fixed, rewriting the shared environment (docs, tickets, how tools are presented) still cuts cost and lifts success: on AutomationBench Claude Haiku 4.5 drops cost 72.7% with +14.34% pass, the same environment transfers to Opus 5 (−68.1% cost), and on top of Meta-Harness it cuts another 83.4% cost with +11.17% accuracy.

Problem An agent's cost and success depend on model, harness, and environment; most work tunes the first two and ignores how multi-task shared “stationary” workspaces like Slack, docs, and tickets are represented.

How & Evidence @dair_ai highlights EnvOpt (Mingxuan Li, Joseph E Gonzalez, Alex Dimakis and coauthors; arXiv:2611.07372): a coding agent runs the target agent on training tasks without graders or reference answers, edits the environment, and stops on a validation set; across 5 benchmarks it cuts cost while holding or raising pass rate and transfers across models and harnesses, and the paper catalogs successful vs rejected environment edits (such as stuffing one file increases exploration).

论文 arXiv:2611.07372 X 原帖 · @dair_ai

items.title: ARI：用推理模型在搜索时的排序偏好做测试时训练，400M cross-encoder 的 Recall@100 最高提升约 7× 并超过 Qwen3-Embedding-8B / ARI: Test-Time Training from a Reasoning Model's Ranking Preferences Lets a 400M Cross-Encoder Grow Recall@100 up to ~7× and Beat Qwen3-Embedding-8B
items.summary: Agent 每次推理哪些检索结果重要，一压缩上下文就把判断扔掉；ARI 把这些无标注偏好摊销进小检索器权重，使 400M cross-encoder 在 held-out 查询上 Recall@100 最高约 7× 增长，并在 Twitter-Conflict / Writing / BRIGHT AoPS 上超过 Qwen3-Embedding-8B。
items.content_html:
核心结论 Agent 每次推理哪些检索结果重要，一压缩上下文就把判断扔掉；ARI 把这些无标注偏好摊销进小检索器权重，使 400M cross-encoder 在 held-out 查询上 Recall@100 最高约 7× 增长，并在 Twitter-Conflict / Writing / BRIGHT AoPS 上超过 Qwen3-Embedding-8B。

问题背景 大规模语料上，即便前沿推理 agent 反复查询最好的检索器，困难查询仍常卡在低召回；如何把推理模型的判断扩展到整库文档？

核心机制与实证 @dianetc_（与 Devavrat Shah、@lateinteraction）提出 Amortized Reasoning Index：小检索器取 top-K → 推理模型重排 → 对比奖励的测试时梯度更新权重 → 同一查询立刻再搜，权重跨查询保留；无相关性标签时，Recall@100 在 Twitter-Conflict / Writing / BRIGHT AoPS 分别约 3.2× / 6.7× / 7× 增长（博客 preliminary results）。

Takeaway Agents spend reasoning deciding which search hits matter, then throw that judgment away on compaction; ARI amortizes those unlabeled preferences into a small retriever's weights so a 400M cross-encoder grows Recall@100 by up to ~7× on held-out queries and ends above Qwen3-Embedding-8B on Twitter-Conflict, Writing, and BRIGHT AoPS.

Problem On large corpora, even frontier reasoning agents that repeatedly query the best retrievers still hit a recall bottleneck on hard queries—how do you scale a reasoning model's judgment across the whole document pool?

How & Evidence @dianetc_ (with Devavrat Shah and @lateinteraction) introduce the Amortized Reasoning Index: a small retriever returns top-K → a reasoning model re-ranks → contrastive-reward test-time gradients update weights → search again on the same query, with weights kept across queries; with no relevance labels, Recall@100 grows about 3.2× / 6.7× / 7× on Twitter-Conflict / Writing / BRIGHT AoPS (blog preliminary results).

博客 X 原帖 · @dianetc_ X 原帖 · @lateinteraction

items.title: How Do AI Agents Waste Your Money：约 18% 输出 token 可删；在线剪枝可砍掉 41% 推理且成功率不掉，同模型不同 harness 账单差很大 / How Do AI Agents Waste Your Money: ~18% of Output Tokens Are Removable; Online Pruning Cuts 41% of Reasoning Without Hurting Success, and Same-Model Harnesses Bill Very Differently
items.summary: Agent 烧 token 的主因往往不是模型太贵，而是可删的重复/绕路与 harness 差异：跨运行约 18% 输出 token 是浪费，在线剪掉法官标出的重复与填充可删 41% 推理且 SWE-bench Verified 成功率 89.0%→89.5%，而同模型五套 harness 的 token 与动作模式差异显著。
items.content_html:
核心结论 Agent 烧 token 的主因往往不是模型太贵，而是可删的重复/绕路与 harness 差异：跨运行约 18% 输出 token 是浪费，在线剪掉法官标出的重复与填充可删 41% 推理且 SWE-bench Verified 成功率 89.0%→89.5%，而同模型五套 harness 的 token 与动作模式差异显著。

问题背景 大家知道 agent 很费 token，但缺少跨异构系统统一度量“哪些 token 其实可删”的方法，也就难决定该剪推理、换模型，还是换 harness。

核心机制与实证 @arkyyang 分享的工作（arXiv:2611.07238）用轨迹记录 + LLM-as-a-Judge 标出 Restate / Duplicate-Fetch / Padding / Detour，再通过删除后续跑验证；任务与工具比模型更能驱动浪费，High→Max 推理档几乎白烧（任务双解时 Max 贵 1.62×），建议默认 High 并按 harness 测浪费而非只看总 token。

Takeaway Agents burn tokens less because the model is pricey than because removable repeats/detours and harness choice pile up: ~18% of output tokens were waste across runs, online pruning of judge-flagged repeats/filler cut 41% of reasoning with SWE-bench Verified success 89.0%→89.5%, and five harnesses with the same model showed markedly different token use and action patterns.

Problem Everyone knows agents spend tokens, but we lacked a unified way across heterogeneous systems to measure which tokens were actually removable—so it is hard to decide whether to prune reasoning, switch models, or switch harnesses.

How & Evidence @arkyyang shares the work (arXiv:2611.07238): trajectory logging plus an LLM-as-a-Judge labels Restate / Duplicate-Fetch / Padding / Detour, then deletion-and-resume validates them; task and tools drive waste more than model choice, High→Max reasoning effort mostly buys nothing (Max costs 1.62× on jointly solved tasks), so default to High and measure waste per harness rather than only total tokens.

论文 arXiv:2611.07238 X 原帖 · @arkyyang

items.title: EnzymeRSI：不动模型权重、只进化酶设计 harness，ProteinGym 平均 Spearman 提升 0.044，湿实验也有真实活性 / EnzymeRSI: Evolving the Enzyme-Design Harness, Not the Weights, Raises ProteinGym Spearman by 0.044 and Yields Real Wet-Lab Activity
items.summary: 不动模型权重、只进化酶设计 harness 有效：外环 harness RSI 使 ProteinGym 平均 Spearman 提升 0.044，湿实验决策也带来真实活性增益——但命中池内排序仍失败（ρ=0.175）。
items.content_html:
核心结论 不动模型权重、只进化酶设计 harness 有效：外环 harness RSI 使 ProteinGym 平均 Spearman 提升 0.044，湿实验决策也带来真实活性增益——但命中池内排序仍失败（ρ=0.175）。

问题背景 定向进化通常在固定流程里优化测哪个突变；当方法或 harness 本身错了，这条循环就逃不出去。

核心机制与实证 @BioAIFrontier 报告的 EnzymeRSI（Genoria AI；arXiv:2611.06321）把 RSI 拆成外环（版本化 prompts/pipelines/skills/subagents，配对比较 12/142 次采纳）与仅在排除流程原因后才启动的内环：外环五项测定平均 Spearman +0.044（CD19 0.314→0.335），内环 ThermoMPNN PCC 0.849、TadA Spearman 0.307（1.13 小时），湿实验含非预先指定的 RLuc 候选 10/32 ≥2× WT、A3A Y130Q 到 90.2% 5mC 并出现偏好反转、KOD-E 路径选择到亲本催化效率的 31.1×，但多轮闭环的干→湿战役尚未展示。

Takeaway Evolving the enzyme-design harness without touching model weights works: an outer harness RSI loop raised mean ProteinGym Spearman by 0.044, and wet-lab decisions yielded real activity gains—but ranking inside the hit pool still failed (ρ=0.175).

Problem Directed evolution usually optimizes which mutants to assay inside a fixed workflow; when the method or harness is wrong, that loop cannot escape.

How & Evidence @BioAIFrontier reports EnzymeRSI (Genoria AI; arXiv:2611.06321), which splits RSI into an outer loop that versions prompts, pipelines, skills and subagents under paired comparisons (12/142 adoptions) and an inner loop that develops predictors only after workflow causes are ruled out: the outer loop adds 0.044 mean Spearman across five assays (CD19 0.314→0.335), the inner loop reaches ThermoMPNN PCC 0.849 and TadA Spearman 0.307 in 1.13 h, and wet-lab decisions yielded 10/32 non-pre-specified RLuc candidates at ≥2× WT, A3A Y130Q at 90.2% 5mC conversion with preference reversal, and KOD-E path selection at 31.1× parent catalytic efficiency, though a multi-round closed dry-to-wet campaign is not yet shown.

论文 arXiv:2611.06321 X 原帖 · @BioAIFrontier

items.title: Harness Leaderboard：同一开源模型下，换 harness 几乎不改解题率，单次成本却能拉开约 12 倍 / Harness Leaderboard: With Open Models Held Fixed, Harness Choice Barely Moves Solve Rate but Swings Cost by About 12×
items.summary: 固定同一开源模型时，coding-agent harness 几乎不改解题率，却能把单次成本拉开约 12 倍——harness 才是多数团队没拧的旋钮。
items.content_html:
核心结论 固定同一开源模型时，coding-agent harness 几乎不改解题率，却能把单次成本拉开约 12 倍——harness 才是多数团队没拧的旋钮。

问题背景 大家比模型时把 agent 外壳当噪声；今年已有三组独立研究指出 harness 是隐藏变量。

核心机制与实证 @joelniklaus 跑了 28,849 次试验（$4,746 推理），在 GLM-5.3-Flash、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 与 Flint 上跨 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 DeepSWE 只换 harness：平均 mini-swe-agent 解题率 51.4%，另有四个统计并列，Pi 为 49.4% 且 $0.29/题，对照 mini-swe-agent 的 $0.53/题，opencode 为 $3.35/题（约 11.7× Pi），且最佳 harness 随模型而变，Harness Lens 记录了 34 个 harness 的 prompts/tools/compaction。

Takeaway With the same open models held fixed, coding-agent harnesses barely move solve rate but swing cost up to ~12×—so the harness is the lever most teams are not pulling.

Problem People compare models while treating the agent wrapper as noise; three independent studies this year show harness choice is a hidden variable.

How & Evidence @joelniklaus ran 28,849 trials ($4,746 inference) on GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Flint across Terminal-Bench 2.1 and DeepSWE, changing only the harness: averaged, mini-swe-agent solves 51.4% with four others statistically tied, Pi hits 49.4% at $0.29/solved against mini-swe-agent at $0.53, and opencode costs $3.35/solved (~11.7× Pi), while the best harness is model-dependent and companion Harness Lens documents prompts, tools and compaction for 34 harnesses.

排行榜 Harness Lens X 原帖 · @joelniklaus X 原帖 · @stretchcloud

items.title: RSI Arena：十个 agent 自主后训练同一底座，人类投票让 8/10 的偏好上升，基准几乎不动 / RSI Arena: Ten Agents Post-Train One Base Model, Human Votes Lift Preference for 8/10, and Benchmarks Barely Move
items.summary: 十个 agent 能从同一底座自主做 post-training，且人类反馈让 8/10 的风格校正偏好上升——但基准提升几乎不动、也不跟偏好同向，因此 RSI 仍需人来定义“更好”。
items.content_html:
核心结论 十个 agent 能从同一底座自主做 post-training，且人类反馈让 8/10 的风格校正偏好上升——但基准提升几乎不动、也不跟偏好同向，因此 RSI 仍需人来定义“更好”。

问题背景 多数 agent 研究评测只对着指定基准跑几小时；从未问 agent 能否做出人们更喜欢的助手、再从用户投票继续改进。

核心机制与实证 RSI Arena（arXiv:2610.33624；Bake AI、Hugging Face 与 NVIDIA）给 10 个前沿 agent 同一 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base、约 1,000 GPU-h 与各 $300 API，先跑 6 天再加 3 天 Human Arena，@my_cat_can_code 发布了结果：Stage 1 中 GPT-6 Astra 在 12 项基准上关闭 base→Instruct 差距的中位 76%，风格控制下人类评分与 NVIDIA Instruct 打平；Stage 2 有 8/10 缩小风格校正差距（中位 +28），DeepSeek 训练的模型跳幅最大（−207→−35），回答中位长度从 61 增至 508 token，基准中位仅 +2 且与偏好变化 ρ=−0.19，另有一个模型的 StrongREJECT 有害顺从率明显上升，作者称之为 RSIHF。

Takeaway Ten agents can autonomously post-train a shared base model, and human feedback then improves style-adjusted preference for 8/10—but benchmark gains barely move and do not track preference, so RSI still needs people to define what “better” means.

Problem Most agent-research evals optimize named benchmarks for hours on few GPUs; they never ask whether agents can build assistants people prefer and then improve from user votes.

How & Evidence RSI Arena (arXiv:2610.33624; Bake AI with Hugging Face and NVIDIA), as posted by @my_cat_can_code, gave 10 frontier agents the same Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base, about 1,000 GPU-h and $300 API each for 6 days, then 3 more days of Human Arena battles: in stage 1 GPT-6 Astra closed a median 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap on 12 benchmarks and tied NVIDIA Instruct under style control, and in stage 2 8/10 narrowed the style-controlled gap to Instruct (median +28 points), the DeepSeek-trained model jumped most (−207 to −35) as median answer length grew from 61 to 508 tokens, the benchmark median changed only +2 points with ρ=−0.19 against the preference change, and one model's StrongREJECT harmful compliance rose sharply, which the authors frame as RSIHF.

论文 arXiv:2610.33624 项目页 模型 X 原帖 · @my_cat_can_code X 原帖 · @my_cat_can_code

items.title: CUGA：同一开源权重，只换 agent harness 就让 AppWorld 完成率从 30% 升到 81% / CUGA: Same Open-Weight Model, Swapping Only the Harness Lifts AppWorld Completion from 30% to 81%
items.summary: 同一开源权重、同一 90 个 AppWorld 任务：只换 agent harness 就让完成率从 30% 到 81%——因为外壳按应用规划、在沙箱写代码执行，并在改状态前后做检查。
items.content_html:
核心结论 同一开源权重、同一 90 个 AppWorld 任务：只换 agent harness 就让完成率从 30% 到 81%——因为外壳按应用规划、在沙箱写代码执行，并在改状态前后做检查。

问题背景 团队选型时把 harness 当可互换件；企业多应用 API 工作需要不同于聊天助手的外壳。

核心机制与实证 IBM Research 的 Hugging Face 博文（@prompt48）用 GLM-5.3-flash 在 AppWorld（90 个任务 / 30 个场景）对比 CUGA、Hermes 与 Deep Agents：TGC 为 CUGA 81.1%（73/90）、Hermes 46.7%、Deep Agents 30.0%，更严的 SGC（三种变体全过）为 20/30、8/30、2/30，因为 CUGA 一次分解一个应用、在沙箱里写 Python（CodeAct）、执行前核验会改状态的代码，再做反思与分页审计；局限是 CUGA 自带 AppWorld 配置且未开 policy，故 81% 不衡量规则强制，同一模型只换 harness 时 GLM 在 SWE-bench Pro 上也可从 23% 升到 52%。

Takeaway Same open-weight model, same 90 AppWorld tasks: swapping only the agent harness moved completion from 30% to 81%—because the wrapper plans per-app, acts in sandboxed code, and checks before/after state changes.

Problem Teams pick models while treating harnesses as interchangeable; enterprise multi-app API work needs a different wrapper than chat assistants.

How & Evidence IBM Research's Hugging Face post, shared by @prompt48, ran CUGA against Hermes and Deep Agents with GLM-5.3-flash on AppWorld (90 tasks / 30 scenarios): task-goal completion was 81.1% (73/90) for CUGA, 46.7% for Hermes and 30.0% for Deep Agents, stricter scenario-goal completion (all 3 variants) was 20/30 versus 8/30 versus 2/30, because CUGA decomposes one app at a time, writes Python (CodeAct) in a sandbox, verifies mutating code before execution, then reflects and pagination-audits, though CUGA is IBM's own harness with AppWorld-specific config and policies were off so the 81% does not measure enforcement, and the same comparison cites a same-model GLM jump from 23% to 52% on SWE-bench Pro by harness alone.

博客 GitHub: cuga-project/cuga-agent 论文 arXiv:2605.20874 X 原帖 · @prompt48

items.title: MSA 自动科研 agent：按 AF3 置信度为每个复合物重做 MSA，在所有基准上超过默认流水线 / Auto-Research MSA Agent: Redesigning Each Complex's MSA from AF3 Confidence Beats the Default Pipeline on Every Benchmark
items.summary: 在测试时为每个复合物重设计 MSA 的自主 agent——只用 AF3 置信度、不用 DockQ——在所有基准上超过 AF3 默认流水线，同时平均少用约 60% 序列，因为 MSA 深度与配对是靶点特异的，不是一条全局配方。
items.content_html:
核心结论 在测试时为每个复合物重设计 MSA 的自主 agent——只用 AF3 置信度、不用 DockQ——在所有基准上超过 AF3 默认流水线，同时平均少用约 60% 序列，因为 MSA 深度与配对是靶点特异的，不是一条全局配方。

问题背景 AF3 流水线通常最大化深度并按物种配对，但配对是否有益仍有争议且最优策略不可迁移。

核心机制与实证 这篇 arXiv:2611.03183 的 Auto-Research Agent（@SciFi）把冻结的 AF3 当作黑箱仪器，提出假设、重组 MSA，并只按无标签置信度而不是 DockQ 迭代；在 1,015 个训练截止后的接口上，整体 DockQ 均值在 FoldBench-v1 从 0.584 升到 0.604、FoldBench-v2-hard 从 0.556 升到 0.583、HD439 从 0.583 升到 0.624，种间异源复合物增益最大（FoldBench 0.465→0.612，HD439 0.482→0.562），提名 MSA 平均深度约为默认的 40%，配对策略主要影响种内异源复合物（约占 HD439 增益的一半）。

Takeaway An autonomous agent that redesigns each complex's MSA at test time—using only AF3 confidence, not DockQ—beats AF3's default pipeline on every benchmark while using ~60% fewer sequences, because MSA depth and pairing are target-specific, not one global recipe.

Problem AF3 pipelines usually maximize MSA depth and pair by species, yet whether pairing helps is contested and optima do not transfer across interfaces.

How & Evidence The Auto-Research Agent on MSA Organization (arXiv:2611.03183), posted by @SciFi, treats frozen AF3 as a black-box instrument—hypothesize, reorganize the MSA, and iterate on label-free confidence rather than DockQ—and on 1,015 post-cutoff interfaces overall DockQ mean rises on FoldBench-v1 (0.584→0.604), FoldBench-v2-hard (0.556→0.583) and HD439 (0.583→0.624), with the largest gains on inter-species heteromers (FoldBench 0.465→0.612; HD439 0.482→0.562), nominated MSAs averaging about 40% of default depth, and pairing policy mattering mainly for intra-species heteromers (about half of the HD439 gain).

论文 arXiv:2611.03183 项目页 X 原帖 · @SciFi

items.title: Exo：把离线 harness 搜索收进任务中的安全运行时自编辑 / Exo: Collapse Offline Harness Search into Safe Runtime Self-Editing During the Task
items.summary: 让 agent 在任务进行中改写自己的 harness，在长时开放世界目标上相对 Codex 与 Pi 把模型费用降 12–53%，在 AppWorld 与 SREGym 上相对同一起始策略（不能自编辑）降 35–61%，因为专长化在同一次运行里复利，而受保护核心把历史与策略激活留在可编辑层之外。
items.content_html:
核心结论 让 agent 在任务进行中改写自己的 harness，在长时开放世界目标上相对 Codex 与 Pi 把模型费用降 12–53%，在 AppWorld 与 SREGym 上相对同一起始策略（不能自编辑）降 35–61%，因为专长化在同一次运行里复利，而受保护核心把历史与策略激活留在可编辑层之外。

问题背景 离线 harness 优化器依赖许多团队没有的基准，并在搜索后冻结策略，因此真实长任务很难低成本地再调工具、上下文拼装，乃至改进策略本身。

核心机制与实证 Exo 把 executor 策略挂成可编辑代码，经独立 guardian 请求替换，并用只追加历史与版本化产物保证坏编辑可回滚；在 RuneScape 战斗与制作上花费比 Codex/Pi 低 12–53%，迁移账号再低 45–82%，AppWorld 留出费用在同为 96.9% 通过率时降 61%，SREGym 诊断中位时间与费用降 35%，Continual Learning Bench 编码含学习费用降 14%，但一次性任务收不回专长化前期成本，较弱模型的自编辑也帮不上忙。

Takeaway Letting an agent rewrite its own harness mid-task cuts model cost by 12–53% versus Codex and Pi on long open-world goals, and by 35–61% versus the same starting policy without self-editing on AppWorld and SREGym, because specialization compounds inside the run while a protected core keeps history and activation outside the editable layer.

Problem Offline harness optimizers need benchmarks many teams lack and freeze the policy after search, so real long tasks cannot cheaply re-tune tools, context assembly, or the improvement strategy itself.

How & Evidence Exo mounts executor policy as editable code, lets the agent request replacement through an independent guardian, and preserves append-only history plus versioned artifacts so a bad edit can roll back; on RuneScape combat and crafting it spends 12–53% less than Codex/Pi and 45–82% less on transfer accounts, AppWorld held-out cost falls 61% at the same 96.9% pass rate, SREGym median diagnosis time and cost fall 35%, and Continual Learning Bench coding cost including learning falls 14%, though one-off quests did not repay the specialization tax and weaker models made unhelpful edits.

items.title: CARE：有 grounding 的生产 RSI 经五轮自蒸馏把坏案例率压到低于前沿 incumbent / CARE: Grounded Production RSI Cuts Bad Cases Below a Frontier Incumbent After Five Self-Distillation Rounds
items.summary: 美团 Keeta 的 31B 客服模型经五轮 RSI 后，在已审查坏案例率上优于 GPT-5.4（1.97% 对 4.60%），因为训练前先做失败归因，并且只用 on-policy self-distillation 纠正第一个错误决策，事后信息只给教师、不给学生。
items.content_html:
核心结论 美团 Keeta 的 31B 客服模型经五轮 RSI 后，在已审查坏案例率上优于 GPT-5.4（1.97% 对 4.60%），因为训练前先做失败归因，并且只用 on-policy self-distillation 纠正第一个错误决策，事后信息只给教师、不给学生。

问题背景 用自研模型替换昂贵的前沿客服模型，需要在 Skill/SOP 不断变化时从自身生产失误里持续学习，又不能把工具或 harness 的 bug 当成权重更新信号。

核心机制与实证 CARE 用受治理的 incumbent 轨迹冷启动，再循环跑 24/7 证据盲检，把非模型故障交给组件负责人，把模型故障截到第一个错误决策，并用 OPSD 训练（冻结的自教师能看到诊断与已验证修复）；五轮后 CARE-31B 坏案例率 1.97%（incumbent 4.60%），仿真准确率 94.1%，在线满意度追平（最近一期 +1.7 点），中位回复延迟降 27.7%，完全替换后每单 serving 成本降 70.5%；而普通 SFT 会崩，DPO 会塌成大量转人工（仿真通过率仅 15.1%）。

Takeaway A Meituan Keeta 31B customer-service model beats GPT-5.4 on inspected bad cases (1.97% vs 4.60%) after five RSI rounds because failures are attributed before training and only the first wrong decision is taught via on-policy self-distillation with hindsight reserved for the teacher.

Problem Replacing a costly frontier support model needs continued learning from the replacement’s own production mistakes under changing Skills and SOPs, without letting tool or harness bugs become weight updates.

How & Evidence CARE cold-starts from governed incumbent traces, then loops 24/7 evidence-blinded inspection, routes non-model faults to component owners, truncates model faults at the first bad decision, and trains with OPSD where a frozen self-teacher sees the diagnosis and verified repair; after five iterations CARE-31B reaches 1.97% bad-case rate (incumbent 4.60%), simulation accuracy 94.1%, online satisfaction parity (+1.7 points latest), 27.7% lower median reply latency, and 70.5% lower serving cost per order once the incumbent is retired, while plain SFT collapsed and DPO collapsed into handoff (15.1% simulation pass).

items.title: Harness 就是模型：脚手架选择可让银行合规正确率摆动最多 11.5 个点并翻转排名 / The Harness Is the Model: Scaffold Choice Moves Banking Conduct Compliance by up to 11.5 Points and Flips Rankings
items.summary: 在固定 LLM 时，仅靠 harness 就能让某一开源权重模型的正确案例率摆动多达 11.5 个点，并翻转谁看起来最合规，因此忽略脚手架的模型风险验证会把部署排错序。
items.content_html:
核心结论 在固定 LLM 时，仅靠 harness 就能让某一开源权重模型的正确案例率摆动多达 11.5 个点，并翻转谁看起来最合规，因此忽略脚手架的模型风险验证会把部署排错序。

问题背景 银行常按“模型”做验证，实际部署却是模型加 harness 的系统，其策略上下文、工具、记忆与审查器都会改变对消费信贷、反洗钱类行为规则的合规表现。

核心机制与实证 四个开源权重模型各跑五种 harness，覆盖 156 个预注册 Northbridge Bank 案例（按已执行工具轨迹计分共 3120 场）；在 qwen3.8-flash-next 上跨度达 11.5 点（同模审查器下 93.6%，策略只能检索时 82.1%），同模审查器把违规从 9.6% 降到 6.4% 且未抬高过度拒答，仍有 26% 的违规在对客消息里否认刚执行的禁止动作，只看对话记录会漏掉。

Takeaway Holding the LLM fixed, the harness alone moved correct-case rates by as much as 11.5 points for one open-weight model and flipped which model looked safest, so model-risk validation that ignores the scaffold will mis-rank deployments.

Problem Banks validate models, but they deploy a model-plus-harness system whose policy context, tools, memory, and reviewers may change compliance with consumer-credit and AML-style conduct rules.

How & Evidence Four open-weight models each ran five harnesses on 156 pre-registered Northbridge Bank cases (3120 scored episodes from the executed tool trace); within qwen3.8-flash-next the spread was 11.5 points (93.6% under a same-model reviewer vs 82.1% when policy was search-only), a same-model reviewer cut violations 9.6%→6.4% without raising over-refusals, and 26% of violations still denied the forbidden action in the customer message, so transcript-only review would miss them.

论文 arXiv:2611.06116 GitHub: mhuyut/harness-is-the-model X 原帖 · @bravr

items.title: ServerBench：自设计 serving 栈的编码 agent 达到参考系统 4.87 倍的每 GPU 美元 token 价值 / ServerBench: Coding Agents That Design Their Own Serving Stack Reach 4.87× Reference Token Value per GPU Dollar
items.summary: 把 serving 设计当成实验循环的 agent，能在“满足延迟约束的每 GPU 美元 token 价值”上最多超出强 vLLM/SGLang 基线 4.87 倍，因为高价值运行会先抬能力再抬并发，并验证这些优化新引入的执行路径。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把 serving 设计当成实验循环的 agent，能在“满足延迟约束的每 GPU 美元 token 价值”上最多超出强 vLLM/SGLang 基线 4.87 倍，因为高价值运行会先抬能力再抬并发，并验证这些优化新引入的执行路径。

问题背景 以往 agent-系统基准把工作负载过度简化并只看加速比，无法衡量编码 agent 能否在真实会话依赖、延迟 SLO 与 GPU 成本下建成完整的专用 LLM 服务器。

核心机制与实证 ServerBench 从最小 Transformers 服务器起步，回放有状态的编码 agent 会话，只对满足冻结 TTFT/TPOT 目标的请求计 dollars-per-dollar，并独立验证提交；在 11 个 agent 模型与三套部署上，33 次运行中 22 次通过验证、13 次超过最强基线，Claude Sonnet 5.5 在 Gemma E4B 上达 2.97 dollars/dollar（相对 vLLM 4.87×），Claude Opus 5.5 在 Qwen3.5 9B 上达 4.40。

Takeaway Agents that treat serving design as an experiment loop can beat strong vLLM/SGLang baselines by up to 4.87× on latency-qualified token value per GPU dollar, because high-value runs grow capacity before concurrency and verify the new execution paths those optimizations introduce.

Problem Prior agent-systems benchmarks oversimplify workloads and score raw speedup, missing whether a coding agent can build a complete specialized LLM server under real session dependencies, latency SLOs, and GPU cost.

How & Evidence ServerBench starts from a minimal Transformers server, replays stateful coding-agent sessions, scores dollars-per-dollar only on requests meeting frozen TTFT/TPOT targets, and independently verifies submissions; across 11 agent models and three deployments, 22 of 33 runs pass verification and 13 beat the strongest baseline, with Claude Sonnet 5.5 at 2.97 dollars/dollar on Gemma E4B (4.87× vLLM) and Claude Opus 5.5 at 4.40 on Qwen3.5 9B.

items.title: Latent Harness：把外部 harness 行为编译成无需提示词 token 的 rank-8 激活偏移 / Latent Harness: Compile External Harness Behaviors into Rank-8 Activation Shifts That Need No Prompt Tokens
items.summary: Harness 的收益可以住进冻结模型里的微小 post-block 激活偏移，而不必每轮重发提示词或改权重：在 10 个预注册设定中有 8 个能恢复源 harness 增益，并把同等评估预算下的 harness 搜索抬高 1.45 倍，因为行为只在编译时付一次代价，之后作为可组合的 bundle 复用。
items.content_html:
核心结论 Harness 的收益可以住进冻结模型里的微小 post-block 激活偏移，而不必每轮重发提示词或改权重：在 10 个预注册设定中有 8 个能恢复源 harness 增益，并把同等评估预算下的 harness 搜索抬高 1.45 倍，因为行为只在编译时付一次代价，之后作为可组合的 bundle 复用。

问题背景 文本 harness 每轮调用都要重发并付费，而用类 LoRA 的权重更新把行为内化又迭代昂贵，且合并时就锁死干预强度。

核心机制与实证 Latent Harness 用教师轨迹或严格过滤的成功 harness 轨迹，在每个 decoder block 输出处训练 rank-8 偏移（约占参数 0.03–0.05%），推理时注入并暴露强度、相位与 shift-space 混合控制且不再附带 harness 文本；在 ToolHop 上同等容量达 60.00%，同容量 LoRA 为 54.74%（全容量 LoRA 需约 11.1 倍参数才到同档），在 T=1300 次评估预算下仅编译库搜索就相对文本改写给出 1.45 倍增益。

Takeaway Harness gains can live inside a frozen model as tiny post-block activation shifts instead of per-call prompt text or weight updates, recovering the source harness in 8 of 10 settings and lifting budget-matched harness search by 1.45× because the behavior is paid once at compile time and then reused as a composable bundle.

Problem Text harnesses are re-sent and re-paid on every call, while internalizing them with LoRA-style weight updates is expensive to iterate and locks strength at merge time.

How & Evidence Latent Harness trains a rank-8 shift (0.03–0.05% of parameters) at every decoder-block output from teacher traces or success-filtered harness trajectories, then injects it at inference with strength, phase, and shift-space mixing controls and no harness text; on ToolHop it reaches 60.00% at matched capacity versus 54.74% for same-capacity LoRA (full LoRA needs 11.1× parameters to match), and a compiled library alone accounts for the 1.45× search multiplier over text mutation at T=1300 evaluations.

items.title: ParetoSaddler：搜索中保留可信的质量–成本 harness 补丁，部署偏好留到最后再选 / ParetoSaddler: Keep Credible Quality–Cost Harness Patches Alive During Search, Apply Deployment Preference Only at the End
items.summary: 联合优化质量与成本的 harness 搜索，中间晋升只问补丁是否在任一目标上有可信进展会更好：过早套用成本偏好会杀掉那些先修失败、稍后才能省钱的改动，而贝叶斯 bootstrap 筛选又能滤掉随机 rollout 带来的噪声。
items.content_html:
核心结论 联合优化质量与成本的 harness 搜索，中间晋升只问补丁是否在任一目标上有可信进展会更好：过早套用成本偏好会杀掉那些先修失败、稍后才能省钱的改动，而贝叶斯 bootstrap 筛选又能滤掉随机 rollout 带来的噪声。

问题背景 自动 harness 优化通常只盯质量，若在每轮中间筛选就套用最终的质量–成本部署偏好，会拒绝当下显得更贵、却能为后续改进铺路的补丁。

核心机制与实证 ParetoSaddler 把晋升与部署分开：候选与父 harness 反复执行，用贝叶斯 bootstrap 的 Pareto 支持度晋升在质量或成本任一方向有可信进展但未必已满足最终偏好的更新，预算耗尽后再按偏好选型；在留出 ClawMark 上质量极端点从 70.86%、$1.17/任务升到 81.35%、$1.01，在 GAIA2 上从 56.22%、$0.78 升到 62.89%、$0.45，且优于只优化质量的 AutoSaddler 并更便宜。

Takeaway Joint quality–cost harness search works better when intermediate promotion only asks whether a patch makes credible progress on either objective, because early cost preference can kill fixes that unlock later savings, and Bayesian bootstrap screening filters noise from stochastic rollouts.

Problem Automatic harness optimization usually optimizes quality alone, and applying a final quality–cost deployment preference at every intermediate screen can reject patches that look expensive now but enable stronger later solutions.

How & Evidence ParetoSaddler separates promotion from deployment: candidates and parents are repeatedly executed, Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support promotes updates that improve quality or cost without already matching the final preference, then the preference selects after the budget ends; on held-out ClawMark the quality-extreme harness moves from 70.86% at $1.17/task to 81.35% at $1.01, and on GAIA2 from 56.22% at $0.78 to 62.89% at $0.45, beating quality-only AutoSaddler while staying cheaper.

论文 arXiv:2611.02079 项目页 X 原帖 · @bvsbharat X 原帖 · @yaelkroy

items.title: PyRUA-REAL：具身 RSI 把物理探索变成持久记忆与可部署机器人技能 / PyRUA-REAL: Embodied RSI Turns Physical Exploration into Persistent Memory and Deployable Robot Skills
items.summary: 当编码 agent 把物理 rollout 留成记忆与可复用技能、并把结果冻成无在线 agent 的程序时，真实机器人能在首次成功后继续改进：在 8 个 Franka 任务上平均成功率 91.1%，在 RoboDojo 上 84.4%，因为探索经验被写进代码，而不是试一次就丢掉。
items.content_html:
核心结论 当编码 agent 把物理 rollout 留成记忆与可复用技能、并把结果冻成无在线 agent 的程序时，真实机器人能在首次成功后继续改进：在 8 个 Franka 任务上平均成功率 91.1%，在 RoboDojo 上 84.4%，因为探索经验被写进代码，而不是试一次就丢掉。

问题背景 LLM 编码 agent 能写机器人程序，但在模型权重固定、遥操作或在线 agent 调用又昂贵时，物理交互如何变成持久能力仍不清楚。

核心机制与实证 PyRUA-REAL 让 researcher 设定实验目标、engineer 实现并诊断，在模型参数冻结下把事实、记忆与技能代码写入持久仓库；冻结核心程序后可无 LM 调用运行。8 个双臂 Franka 任务的开发记录平均成功率 91.1%；在 42 个 RoboDojo 任务上冻结核心程序能力平均 84.4%，对比 PyRUA-Lean 的 50.35%；以太网插接仍需在线协助，说明并非所有接触丰富任务都能纯离线。

Takeaway Coding agents can keep improving real robots after the first success when they retain physical rollouts as memory and reusable skills and freeze the result into agent-free programs, reaching 91.1% average success on eight Franka tasks and 84.4% on RoboDojo because exploration experience is written into code rather than discarded after one trial.

Problem LLM coding agents can write robot programs, but it is unclear how physical interaction should become lasting capability when model weights stay fixed and each teleop or online agent call is expensive.

How & Evidence PyRUA-REAL pairs a researcher that sets experiment goals with an engineer that implements, runs, and diagnoses, storing facts, memories, and skill code in a persistent repository while model parameters stay frozen; frozen offline programs then run without LM calls. Across eight dual-arm Franka tasks recorded development success averages 91.1%, and frozen programs score 84.4% capability-averaged on 42 RoboDojo tasks versus 50.35% for PyRUA-Lean; Ethernet insertion still needed online assistance, showing offline code is not yet enough for every contact-rich case.

论文 arXiv:2611.06768 项目页 X 原帖 · @embodiedaiwatch

items.title: dim：开源事件时间线 agent harness，支持环境感知、历史召回与分支“分神” / dim: An Open-Source Event-Timeline Agent Harness for Environment Sensing, History Recall, and Branching Focus
items.summary: 以只追加的事件时间线、而不是聊天消息列表为中心的 agent harness，能让同一个 agent 感知环境、结构化召回历史，并分支并行“分神”，而不必把每条线都当成另一个 subagent 身份。
items.content_html:
核心结论 以只追加的事件时间线、而不是聊天消息列表为中心的 agent harness，能让同一个 agent 感知环境、结构化召回历史，并分支并行“分神”，而不必把每条线都当成另一个 subagent 身份。

问题背景 多数 agent harness 仍按回合制消息列表与模型请求组织工作，难以支撑需要环境事件、持久历史与并行探索的长跑 agent。

核心机制与实证 dim（MIT）把不可变事件当作核心基底——用户输入、判断、行动、工具结果与 harness 自身工作都成为时间线事件并由 capability 状态机消费——同时用元提示、结构化历史召回、在并行分神中保持统一“我”的时间线分支，以及基于 rutis、可用 TypeScript/Go/Python/Swift/Kotlin 扩展的插件躯体来扩展能力；@ashfold 以长文 X Article 发布并解释了设计。

Takeaway An agent harness centered on an append-only event timeline, rather than a chat message list, lets one agent sense its environment, recall structured history, and branch into parallel focus without treating every thread as a separate subagent identity.

Problem Most agent harnesses still organize work around turn-based message lists and model requests, which under-serve long-running agents that need environment events, durable history, and parallel exploration.

How & Evidence dim (MIT) makes immutable events the core substrate—user input, judgments, actions, tool results, and harness work become timeline events consumed by capability state machines—while meta-prompts, structured history recall, timeline branches that keep a shared “I” across parallel focus, and a rutis-based plugin body spanning TypeScript, Go, Python, Swift, and Kotlin extend that body; @ashfold announced the release in a long X Article detailing the design.

GitHub: arcships/dim X 原帖 · @ashfold

items.title: FreeForm Harness：移动原生开放扩展基底，设备本地准入把信任留在手机上 / FreeForm Harness: A Mobile-Native Open Extension Substrate Where Device-Local Admission Keeps Trust On-Phone
items.summary: 移动端 agent 的开放性需要一个有“永久层”意识的 harness：把定位、主动触发与稀缺通道吸收进始终在场的角色，让第三方与终端用户能发布或委托生成插件，而最终准入仍在设备本地——Android 原型在不扩大声明组合空间的前提下闭合了 50 个日常案例中的 44 个。
items.content_html:
核心结论 移动端 agent 的开放性需要一个有“永久层”意识的 harness：把定位、主动触发与稀缺通道吸收进始终在场的角色，让第三方与终端用户能发布或委托生成插件，而最终准入仍在设备本地——Android 原型在不扩大声明组合空间的前提下闭合了 50 个日常案例中的 44 个。

问题背景 手机已具备日常 agent 任务所需能力碎片，但现有移动 agent 把它们融进单体流水线，用户与第三方没有可安装的重组入口。

核心机制与实证 FreeForm Harness（高德 / 阿里）划分冻结基座 L0、可替换但永久的必需层 L1 与开放层 L2，统一插件契约；先检索市场，未命中再按层级委托生成。在小米 14 Pro、Android 16 原型上强制执行了声明边界，50 个基准案例全部落入五维组合空间，端到端闭合 44/50（检索 17、委托生成 27；诚实非闭合 6），优于仅闭合 17/50 的配方式自动化基线。

Takeaway Mobile agent openness needs a permanence-aware harness that absorbs location, proactive triggers, and scarce channels into always-present roles, so third parties and end users can publish or commission plugins while final admission stays device-local—closing 44 of 50 daily-life cases on an Android prototype without widening the declared composition space.

Problem Phones already have the pieces for everyday agent tasks, but current mobile agents fuse them into monolithic pipelines with no open recombination point for users or third parties.

How & Evidence FreeForm Harness (Amap / Alibaba) splits a frozen base L0, a replaceable-but-permanent required layer L1, and an open L2 under one plugin contract, with retrieval-first marketplace hits and tiered commissioned authoring on misses. On a Xiaomi 14 Pro Android 16 prototype it enforced the claimed boundaries, represented all 50 benchmark cases in a five-dimensional composition space, closed 44/50 end-to-end (17 retrieval, 27 commissioned; 6 honest non-closures), and beat a recipe-style automation baseline that closed only 17/50.

论文 arXiv:2611.04579 X 原帖 · @ComputerPapers

items.title: CLEO：autoresearch 式循环围绕自托管模型从零长出 3000 行 harness，准确率几乎追平 Claude Code SDK / CLEO: An Autoresearch Loop Grows a 3,000-Line Harness Around a Self-Hosted Model That Nearly Matches the Claude Code SDK
items.summary: 围绕一个固定的开源权重模型、几乎从零长出来的小 harness，准确率只比大得多的 Claude Code SDK 低 1.2 个点，原因是优化循环只保留既能提分、又通过“是否通用、可审计、值得多出来的能力面”检查的改动。
items.content_html:
核心结论 围绕一个固定的开源权重模型、几乎从零长出来的小 harness，准确率只比大得多的 Claude Code SDK 低 1.2 个点，原因是优化循环只保留既能提分、又通过“是否通用、可审计、值得多出来的能力面”检查的改动。

问题背景 对安全敏感的情报分析团队必须在自托管模型上运行 agent，并审查 harness 暴露的每个工具和每行代码，因此现成的大 harness 难以过审，而裸 harness 又不够强。

核心机制与实证 监督模型（Claude Opus 4.8）驱动“提议—测试—保留”循环：GLM-5.1 起步时只有 ls、read、grep、沙箱 Python 和按案件的持久记忆，每次改动在 44 道题上打分（32 道固定加 12 道每轮新抽），并定期换成分布外案件，只有超过准确率门槛且通过“合理性闸门”的改动才保留，一个 agent 很少调用的 cite() 工具就因此被撤回。在循环从未见过的 240 道留出题上，CLEO（约 3k 行）通过率 83.8%，Claude Code SDK（据报道约 512k 行）为 85.0%，裸 PI harness（约 75k 行）为 80.8%；从 PI 自上而下做裁剪的循环准确率相当，但代码几乎没变小，不过评分依赖只做过抽查的 LLM 评审。

Takeaway A tiny agent harness grown from almost nothing around a fixed open-weights model comes within 1.2 points of the far larger Claude Code SDK, because the optimization loop only keeps an edit that both raises accuracy and passes a check that it is generic, auditable and worth the extra surface.

Problem Security-sensitive intelligence teams must run agents on self-hosted models and review every tool and line of harness code, so a large off-the-shelf harness is hard to certify while a bare one is weaker.

How & Evidence A supervisor model (Claude Opus 4.8) runs a propose-test-keep loop that starts GLM-5.1 with only ls, read, grep, sandboxed Python and per-case memory, scores each change on 44 questions (32 fixed plus 12 freshly sampled), periodically swaps in an out-of-distribution case, and keeps a change only if it clears an accuracy margin and the justification gate, which is how a rarely used cite() helper got reverted. On 240 held-out questions the loop never saw, CLEO (about 3k lines) passes 83.8% against 85.0% for the Claude Code SDK (reportedly about 512k lines) and 80.8% for the bare PI harness (about 75k lines), and a top-down loop that pruned PI matched the accuracy but barely shrank the code, though grading relies on an LLM judge that was only spot-checked.
