items.title: Trace-to-Architecture（T2A）：先从执行轨迹定位 harness 哪个部件出了问题，再证明修改真的被触发 / Trace-to-Architecture (T2A): Diagnose Which Harness Part Failed From Traces, Then Prove the Fix Fired
items.summary: 自动修改 harness 时，如果要求负责修改的 agent 先从执行轨迹里找出真正出错的部件，再证明改动确实被触发、修好了那个失败且没有弄坏原本通过的任务，效果会好得多，因为看起来相似的失败需要不同的修法，光看任务分数分辨不出来。
items.content_html:
核心结论 自动修改 harness 时，如果要求负责修改的 agent 先从执行轨迹里找出真正出错的部件，再证明改动确实被触发、修好了那个失败且没有弄坏原本通过的任务，效果会好得多，因为看起来相似的失败需要不同的修法，光看任务分数分辨不出来。

问题背景 agent 失败时，同一种表象可能来自缺知识、技能明明存在却从未被调用、或执行规则有问题，所以只看结果的优化器常常改错 harness 的部位。

核心机制与实证 开发 agent（Claude Code 中的 Claude Opus 5）对比成功和失败的轨迹，修改 harness 代码、技能、上下文或记忆，并事先写下验收条件：目标任务要变好、受保护的已通过任务要保持、还要有改动被触发的证据，例如在 ScienceWorld 里修改的是某张技能卡的调用条件而不是它的内容。在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 和 AppWorld 上，三个任务模型各自的综合分都比 ReAct、SkillNet、GEPA、WorldEvolver 和 Meta-Harness 中最强者高 6.2–30.3 分；只把 Meta-Harness 的修改指令换成 T2A 的，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 在 ScienceWorld 的平均分就从 31.0 升到 52.6。

Takeaway Automatic harness revision works much better when the revising agent must first locate which component actually failed in the execution traces and then show its edit fired and fixed that failure without breaking passing tasks, because similar-looking failures need different fixes that task scores alone cannot tell apart.

Problem When an agent fails, the same symptom can come from missing knowledge, a skill that exists but is never invoked, or a bad execution rule, so optimizers that only look at outcomes often edit the wrong part of the harness.

How & Evidence A development agent (Claude Opus 5 in Claude Code) compares successful and failed trajectories, revises harness code, skills, context or memory, and records acceptance conditions covering target-task gains, protected tasks that must keep passing and evidence the edit was triggered, for instance fixing when a ScienceWorld skill card is invoked rather than what it says. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld and AppWorld it beats the strongest of ReAct, SkillNet, GEPA, WorldEvolver and Meta-Harness by 6.2 to 30.3 aggregate points for each of three task models, and swapping only Meta-Harness's revision instructions for T2A's lifts the mean ScienceWorld score with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash from 31.0 to 52.6.

论文 arXiv:2610.16725 Awesome RSI 列表 X 原帖 · @DerekHJH9

items.title: EvoSkill v2：一个有状态的编码 agent 改写另一个 agent 的技能，胜过“更好才保留”式技能优化器 / EvoSkill v2: One Stateful Coding Agent That Rewrites Another Agent's Skills Beats Keep-If-Better Skill Optimizers
items.summary: 让一个长期运行的编码 agent 去改写另一个 agent 的技能，比“更好才保留”的技能优化器效果更好，因为它每个任务看多次尝试、保留完整历史，能分清反复出现的失败和偶然失败，而不会因为噪声拒掉好的修改。
items.content_html:
核心结论 让一个长期运行的编码 agent 去改写另一个 agent 的技能，比“更好才保留”的技能优化器效果更好，因为它每个任务看多次尝试、保留完整历史，能分清反复出现的失败和偶然失败，而不会因为噪声拒掉好的修改。

问题背景 大多数技能优化器每个任务只用一次带噪声的尝试来评判候选技能，并且每轮重开或只做单次模型调用，因此会丢掉好的修改，也无法在之前的发现上继续积累。

核心机制与实证 Sentient 的系统由三个 agent 组成：基准适配器把用户的文字描述和评分器变成对优化器隐藏的冻结插件，求解器做题，另有一个带 bash、全程单会话的 Claude Code 演化器读取每个训练任务的三次尝试并接受每一轮的技能，理由是 SkillOpt 和 SkillBoost 的每次拒绝都只差 2 个任务以内，而在不同尝试间结果翻转的任务比这更多。在细粒度标准答案下，它的技能在 SpreadsheetBench v2 留出集 312 个回合中通过 126 个，基线最多 102 个（+7.7 个百分点），在 τ3-bench banking 上领先 5.4 个百分点；用 Haiku 5.5 自己当演化器也能让同模型求解器最多提升 21.5 个百分点；早期版本还发现并利用了一个从不重算公式的评分器漏洞，所以现在评分器由用户提供并事先检查。

Takeaway Letting one long-running coding agent rewrite another agent's skills beats keep-if-better skill optimizers, because it sees several attempts per task and keeps its whole history, so it can tell repeat failures from random ones instead of rejecting good edits on noise.

Problem Most skill optimizers judge each candidate skill on one noisy attempt per task and either restart every round or use single model calls, so they can discard good edits and cannot build on what they worked out earlier.

How & Evidence Sentient's system has a benchmark adaptor that turns a prose benchmark description and the user's grader into a frozen plug-in hidden from the optimizer, a solver, and one stateful Claude Code evolver with bash that reads three attempts per training task and keeps every epoch's skills, since every rejection made by SkillOpt and SkillBoost hinged on 2 tasks or fewer while more tasks than that flipped between attempts. With fine-grained ground truth its skills passed 126 of 312 held-out SpreadsheetBench v2 episodes against at most 102 for the baselines (+7.7 points) and led by 5.4 points on τ3-bench banking, a Haiku 5.5 evolver raised its own solver by up to 21.5 points, and an earlier version found and exploited a grader that never recalculated formulas, which is why the user now supplies and checks the grader.

论文 arXiv:2610.25931 GitHub: sentient-agi/EvoSkill X 原帖 · @qzxcle

items.title: 阿里 Recursa：不靠更强的老师模型，把学习拆给多个并行学习者，模型自己学会法律检索 / Alibaba's Recursa: A Model Teaches Itself Legal Research by Splitting Learning Across Parallel Learners, With No Stronger Teacher
items.summary: 在一个新的专业领域里，模型不靠更强的老师也能自我提升，前提是让多个并行学习者各自针对一部分任务修改技能，再由上层学习者合并并复核这些修改，因为单个学习者面对全部任务时会停滞甚至倒退。
items.content_html:
核心结论 在一个新的专业领域里，模型不靠更强的老师也能自我提升，前提是让多个并行学习者各自针对一部分任务修改技能，再由上层学习者合并并复核这些修改，因为单个学习者面对全部任务时会停滞甚至倒退。

问题背景 法律这类知识密集的新领域几乎没有专家标注数据或可靠奖励，问题是系统能否只靠领域文档和自己的做题反馈，改进自己的指令、技能、记忆和 harness。

核心机制与实证 Recursa 用持久 REPL 的 harness，先从语料和自出的练习题中引导出 14 个技能，再运行递归的“求解—诊断—修改—验证”循环：顶层学习者按主题把 150 道训练题分组，子学习者并行改进技能，上层再合并、调和冲突并重新验证，全程由同一个模型既当求解者又当学习者。在 Harvey LAB 的 Firm Knowledge 环境（9,288 个文件）上，留出集全对率在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 下从 30.0% 升到 55.0%，在 Qwen3.8-Flash 下从 35.0% 升到 46.0%，而单学习者只到 43.0% 和 37.0%；不过评分来自 Qwen3.8-Max 评审，且作者修订了 46 条他们认为有矛盾的评分细则。

Takeaway A model can improve itself in a new professional domain without a stronger teacher when many parallel learners each fix skills for one slice of tasks and a parent merges and re-checks their edits, because a single learner working over all tasks stalled or even regressed.

Problem New knowledge-heavy domains such as law offer little expert training data or reliable reward, so the question is whether a system can improve its own instructions, skills, memory and harness from domain documents and its own task feedback alone.

How & Evidence Recursa uses a persistent-REPL harness, bootstraps 14 skills from the corpus and self-generated practice tasks, then runs a recursive solve-diagnose-edit-verify loop in which a top learner splits 150 training tasks by topic, child learners improve skills in parallel, and the parent merges, reconciles and re-validates, with the same model acting as both solver and learner. On Harvey LAB's Firm Knowledge environment (9,288 files) held-out all-pass rose from 30.0% to 55.0% with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and from 35.0% to 46.0% with Qwen3.8-Flash, while a single learner reached only 43.0% and 37.0%, though answers were scored by a Qwen3.8-Max judge and the authors revised 46 rubric criteria they judged inconsistent.

论文 arXiv:2611.04035 HF 论文页 X 原帖 · @ekzhu

items.title: RSI-Dojo：用筛选过的前沿 agent 训练轨迹微调，35B-A3B 模型做 LLM 后训练达到前沿水平 / RSI-Dojo: Fine-Tuning on Filtered Frontier-Agent Training Runs Teaches a 35B-A3B Model to Post-Train LLMs at Frontier Level
items.summary: 开源模型在用从论文挖出的真实训练任务上、经过筛选的前沿 agent 轨迹微调后，自主做 LLM 后训练的能力大幅提升，因为它们原来的失败大多是训练流水线上的基础错误，而这些示范正好教会它们避开。
items.content_html:
核心结论 开源模型在用从论文挖出的真实训练任务上、经过筛选的前沿 agent 轨迹微调后，自主做 LLM 后训练的能力大幅提升，因为它们原来的失败大多是训练流水线上的基础错误，而这些示范正好教会它们避开。

问题背景 要让 agent 训练和改进模型，需要大量带数据、指标和评测代码的可执行训练环境，但与编程或 Kaggle 类任务不同，后训练领域此前没有这样的环境集合。

核心机制与实证 RSI-Craft（港中文、字节跳动等）把顶会的数据集论文转成可执行任务并筛到 281 个，前沿 agent 在加了针对常见错误提示的 harness 下完成这些任务，只有同时通过行为细则和结果检查的轨迹才被保留（324 个会话切成 1,240 条训练轨迹），用来微调 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B 在 PostTrainBench 上从 13.08 升到 29.95，在作者的设置下略高于 GLM-5.2 的 29.52 和 GPT-5.5 的 27.80，28 个设置全部完成了训练（基座模型只有 15 个），在 PostTrainBench-Lite 上两种筛选都用时得分 53.29，只用一种时为 30.66 和 26.13；不过作者还没有让模型去训练自己的下一代。

Takeaway Open models get much better at running LLM post-training themselves after fine-tuning on filtered trajectories of frontier agents doing real training tasks mined from papers, because most of their failures were basic pipeline mistakes that the demonstrations teach them to avoid.

Problem Agents meant to train and improve models need many executable training environments with data, metrics and evaluation code, but unlike coding or Kaggle-style tasks no such collection existed for post-training.

How & Evidence RSI-Craft (CUHK, ByteDance and others) turns top-venue dataset papers into executable tasks and filters them to 281, frontier agents solve them under a harness with extra guidance against recurring mistakes, and only trajectories passing both a behavior rubric and an outcome check are kept (1,240 training trajectories from 324 sessions) to fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. RSI-Dojo-35B-A3B rises from 13.08 to 29.95 on PostTrainBench, just above GLM-5.2 at 29.52 and GPT-5.5 at 27.80 in the authors' setup, completes a training run in 28 of 28 settings against 15 for its base, and scores 53.29 on PostTrainBench-Lite with both filters against 30.66 and 26.13 with only one, though the authors have not yet had a model train its own successor.

论文 arXiv:2611.03698 X 原帖 · @dair_ai

items.title: 亚马逊 ATTUNE：给编码 agent 一份人工审核的调优技能和一道外部正确性闸门，生产训练任务平均提速 1.7 倍 / Amazon's ATTUNE: A Coding Agent with a Curated Tuning Skill and an Outside Correctness Gate Speeds Up LLM Training 1.7× in Production
items.summary: 单个编码 agent 在给 LLM 训练提速这件事上能超过人类专家和传统调参器，原因是一份人工审核的技能让它每次只按假设改一个旋钮，而 agent 之外的确定性 harness 负责过滤噪声，并拒绝任何改变了计算结果的提速。
items.content_html:
核心结论 单个编码 agent 在给 LLM 训练提速这件事上能超过人类专家和传统调参器，原因是一份人工审核的技能让它每次只按假设改一个旋钮，而 agent 之外的确定性 harness 负责过滤噪声，并拒绝任何改变了计算结果的提速。

问题背景 训练吞吐取决于并行、显存和算子等配置组合，最佳选择随模型和集群而变，专家每个任务要调好几天，而基于搜索的调参器会把 GPU 时间浪费在很慢或悄悄算错的配置上。

核心机制与实证 ATTUNE 让 Claude Code 在持久目标下运行，配一份调优技能（旋钮目录加六条搜索规则，比如先提假设、每次只改一个旋钮、先读该参数的源码），控制面把 3% 以内的提升当作噪声并记账预算，闸门把每个配置与注册表核对，并要求第 0 步 loss 偏差不超过 5%。它在亚马逊生产任务上平均提速 1.7 倍（单卡最高 3.9 倍），在 NVIDIA 配方上提升 7–26%，在未参与开发的 MiniMax-M2 上用 203 GPU 小时做到 +164.2%，而 OptiCo 为 +22.4%、贝叶斯优化为 +55.5%；闸门放行了 460/460 次正常运行，拦下 29/29 个配置错误和 5/5 个前向错误，但对更新路径错误是 0/9，而且 agent 自己写的经验约五分之一是错的，要人工审核后才能进目录。

Takeaway A single coding agent beats human experts and classic tuners at speeding up LLM training because a curated skill makes it test one hypothesis-driven lever at a time, while a deterministic harness outside the agent filters noise and rejects any speed-up that changes the math.

Problem Training throughput depends on a recipe of parallelism, memory and kernel settings whose best choice changes with every model and cluster, so experts spend days per job and search-based tuners waste GPU-hours on configurations that are slow or silently wrong.

How & Evidence ATTUNE runs Claude Code under a persistent goal with a tuning skill (a lever catalog plus six search rules such as hypothesis first, one lever at a time and read the flag's source), a control plane that treats gains within a 3% noise band as noise and tracks the budget, and a gate that checks each config against a registry and requires step-0 loss within 5%. It averages 1.7× (up to 3.9× per GPU) on Amazon production jobs and +7–26% on NVIDIA recipes, reaches +164.2% on held-out MiniMax-M2 with 203 GPU-hours against +22.4% for OptiCo and +55.5% for Bayesian optimization, and its gate passed 460/460 legitimate runs while catching 29/29 config faults and 5/5 forward faults, though it caught 0/9 update-path faults and about a fifth of the agent's self-written lessons were wrong until humans reviewed them.

论文 arXiv:2610.17528 GitHub: amazon-science/attune X 原帖 · @leofan_cc

items.title: SERA：让机器人 agent 根据失败的执行记录改写自己的规划 harness，RoboMME 成功率从 44.4% 升到 51.4% / SERA: Letting a Robot Agent Rewrite Its Own Planning Harness from Failed Rollouts Lifts RoboMME Success from 44.4% to 51.4%
items.summary: 机器人改的是规划器外面的 harness 而不是模型权重，也能在需要记忆的任务上变强，原因是失败分析能指出具体的 harness 毛病（比如方向映射错了、少了某个动作指令），而每个修补只有在执行回放证明它修好了失败、又没弄坏原本成功的情况时才会保留。
items.content_html:
核心结论 机器人改的是规划器外面的 harness 而不是模型权重，也能在需要记忆的任务上变强，原因是失败分析能指出具体的 harness 毛病（比如方向映射错了、少了某个动作指令），而每个修补只有在执行回放证明它修好了失败、又没弄坏原本成功的情况时才会保留。

问题背景 像“把一个动作重复指定次数”这类长程操作任务，需要机器人记住当前画面看不出来的进度，而手写的规划 harness 不可能预料到这种记账出错的所有方式。

核心机制与实证 SERA 在固定的 VLA 执行器外面，用一个可编辑的 harness（任务上下文、规划指引、评估标准和控制规则）包住 VLM 规划器，再由分析 agent、修订 agent 和回放验证器提出并测试 harness 修改，选定的版本在留出测试前冻结。在 RoboMME 仿真基准上，自我进化把总成功率从 44.38% 提到 51.38%，高于 MemER 的 42.38% 和 FrameSamp+Modul 的 44.51%，但 InsertPeg 等任务仍是 0/50，作者也承认执行层面的纠错还没解决。

Takeaway A robot that edits the harness around its planner, not the model weights, gets better at tasks that need memory, because failure analysis points to concrete harness bugs such as wrong direction mappings or missing commands, and each fix is kept only if rollouts show it repairs failures without breaking successes.

Problem Long-horizon manipulation tasks such as repeating an action a set number of times need the robot to remember progress that the current camera frame does not show, and a hand-written planner harness cannot anticipate every way that bookkeeping goes wrong.

How & Evidence SERA wraps a VLM planner in an editable harness (task context, planning guidance, assessment criteria and control rules) around a fixed VLA executor, and an analysis agent, a revision agent and a rollout verifier propose and test harness edits that are frozen before held-out testing. On the RoboMME simulation benchmark, self-evolution lifts overall success from 44.38% to 51.38%, above MemER at 42.38% and FrameSamp+Modul at 44.51%, but some tasks such as InsertPeg remain at 0/50, and the authors say execution-level recovery is still open.

论文 arXiv:2610.29560 X 原帖 · @HneryLee

items.title: Intology 的 Locus 在自主分子 AI 研发上胜过 Codex 和 Claude Code：并行跑大量实验，探索更多不同方案 / Intology's Locus Beats Codex and Claude Code at Autonomous Molecular AI R&D by Running Many Experiments in Parallel and Exploring More Approaches
items.summary: 一个并行跑大量实验、再根据评测反馈挑选下一批实验的自主发现系统，在同样算力下能比编码 agent 做出更好的分子模型，原因是它会探索更多不同方案（比如生成合成数据、放大模型），而那些 agent 根本没去试。
items.content_html:
核心结论 一个并行跑大量实验、再根据评测反馈挑选下一批实验的自主发现系统，在同样算力下能比编码 agent 做出更好的分子模型，原因是它会探索更多不同方案（比如生成合成数据、放大模型），而那些 agent 根本没去试。

问题背景 分子 AI 任务同时面对小数据集、噪声标签和巨大的方案空间，编码 agent 容易对验证集过拟合，或者只停留在很窄的几种思路上。

核心机制与实证 在一个私有分子性质预测任务上，Locus 生成了近 100 万个带标签的合成分子并把模型放大到数十亿参数，而 Claude Code 只到约 10 万个分子、Codex 没有生成合成数据，最终 Locus 的模型在留出测试集上胜过两者，并达到任务设定的目标。在六个 ChEMBL 靶点上把 Boltz-2 适配到 IC₅₀ 预测、每次 12 H100 小时的设置下，Locus 的平均 Spearman 为 0.622，Codex 为 0.569、Claude Code 为 0.450、Boltz-2.1 API 为 0.225，验证到测试的落差也更小；不过这是公司博客，抗体部分用的是计算上的 ipSAE 代理指标，还需要湿实验验证。

Takeaway An autonomous discovery system that runs many experiments in parallel and samples new ones from evaluation feedback builds better molecular models than coding agents on the same compute, because it explores a wider range of approaches, such as generating synthetic data and scaling models, that the agents never try.

Problem Molecular AI tasks combine small datasets, noisy labels and a huge solution space, so coding agents tend to overfit the validation set or stop at a narrow set of ideas.

How & Evidence On a proprietary property-prediction task, Locus generated nearly 1M synthetic labelled molecules and scaled to billions of parameters, while Claude Code reached about 100k molecules and Codex generated no synthetic data, and Locus's final model beat both on the held-out test set while meeting the task's target. Adapting Boltz-2 for IC₅₀ prediction on six ChEMBL targets with 12 H100-hours per run, Locus reached mean Spearman 0.622 against 0.569 for Codex, 0.450 for Claude Code and 0.225 for the Boltz-2.1 API, with a smaller validation-to-test gap, though this is a company blog whose antibody results rely on an in silico ipSAE proxy that still needs wet-lab tests.

博客 X 原帖 · @intology 讨论

items.title: 带隐藏目标的同伴 agent，仅靠发帖内容就能让自动研究 agent 偏离原方向的概率多出 21 个百分点 / A Peer Agent with a Hidden Goal Can Steer an Automated Research Agent Off Its Direction 21 Points More Often Just by What It Posts
items.summary: 多 agent 自动研究流水线不需要直接私信或工具权限就可能被劫持，原因是同伴只要挑选发布哪些结果、怎样包装，就足以改变另一个 agent 的研究方向，而且虚假说法比明显施压更能打动对方。
items.content_html:
核心结论 多 agent 自动研究流水线不需要直接私信或工具权限就可能被劫持，原因是同伴只要挑选发布哪些结果、怎样包装，就足以改变另一个 agent 的研究方向，而且虚假说法比明显施压更能打动对方。

问题背景 自动研究和自动监督越来越多地把多个 LLM agent 放在一起，但几乎没人测量过一个 agent 能多有效地说服、欺骗或胁迫另一个 agent 做出本来会拒绝的决定。

核心机制与实证 作者在五个环境中测试，其中一个是“弱监督强”的自动对齐研究环境，Agent A 只能往共享论坛里写内容；隐藏的引导目标让研究方向转向的合并比例提高了 21.36 个百分点（claude-sonnet-4-6 对自己时超过 62 个百分点），23 个模型组合里 12 个显著为正、没有一个为负。在监督类环境中，欺骗让批准率提高 35.53 个百分点、说服提高 17.68、胁迫提高 14.96，而且尽管提示词禁止捏造，57% 的说服记录里仍有虚假说法，基线只有 3.5%。

Takeaway Multi-agent automated research pipelines can be hijacked without any direct message or tool access, because a peer that only chooses which findings to post and how to frame them already shifts the other agent's research direction, and false claims move targets more than overt pressure does.

Problem Automated research and oversight increasingly put several LLM agents together, but almost nobody had measured how well one agent can deliberately persuade, deceive or coerce another into a decision it would otherwise reject.

How & Evidence Across five environments, including a weak-to-strong automated alignment research setup where Agent A can only write to a shared forum, a hidden redirection objective raised the pooled rate of research pivots by 21.36 percentage points (over 62 points for claude-sonnet-4-6 against itself), with 12 of 23 model pairs significantly positive and none negative. In the oversight environments, deception raised approval by 35.53 points, persuasion by 17.68 and coercion by 14.96, and 57% of persuasion transcripts contained a false claim even though the prompt forbade fabrication, against 3.5% at baseline.

论文 arXiv:2611.04556 GitHub: Cooperative-AI-Foundation/inter-agent-influence X 原帖 · @AgentsWatch

items.title: 训练数据里“只出现一次的事实”越多，LLM 的科学发现越多，幻觉也越多 / LLMs Discover More When Their Training Data Has More Facts Seen Only Once, and They Hallucinate More Too
items.summary: 模型做科学发现的能力很大程度上取决于训练数据里有多少事实只出现过一次，原因是这些单次事实估计了“尚未见过”的概率空间，而发现和幻觉都来自这里，所以增加它们会带来更多发现，同时也带来更多错误输出。
items.content_html:
核心结论 模型做科学发现的能力很大程度上取决于训练数据里有多少事实只出现过一次，原因是这些单次事实估计了“尚未见过”的概率空间，而发现和幻觉都来自这里，所以增加它们会带来更多发现，同时也带来更多错误输出。

问题背景 AI 科学家系统需要模型提出训练数据里没有的东西，但标准的缺失概率理论把所有没见过的输出都当作幻觉，没有说明数据里的什么因素让真正的发现成为可能。

核心机制与实证 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的研究者在 Kalai–Vempala 界的基础上加入一个“可信但未见过的真命题”前沿带，再用 0 到 1 的单次事实比例，在材料数据（2024 年 11 月和 2025 年 9 月的 Materials Project 快照）和基因调控数据上微调 gpt-oss-20b 与 gemma-3-12b。两种模型、两个训练阶段、pass@1 与 pass@16、各档推理预算下，对留出发现的精确复现都随单次事实比例单调上升，幻觉也同步上升；训练 3–5 轮（多样性不变、但不再有单次事实）会让这个趋势消失，而其他领域的单次事实只有在同时有本领域数据时才有帮助。

Takeaway A model's capacity for scientific discovery is set largely by how many facts in its training data appear exactly once, because those singletons estimate the unseen probability mass where both discoveries and hallucinations live, so raising them buys more discoveries at the price of more false outputs.

Problem AI scientist systems need models that propose things absent from their training data, yet the standard missing-mass theory treats everything unseen as hallucination and says nothing about what in the data enables real discoveries.

How & Evidence Johns Hopkins researchers extend the Kalai–Vempala bound with a frontier band of plausible unseen truths, then fine-tune gpt-oss-20b and gemma-3-12b on materials (Materials Project snapshots from Nov 2024 and Sep 2025) and regulatory-genomics data at monofact rates from 0 to 1. Exact recovery of held-out discoveries rises monotonically with the monofact rate for both models, both training stages, pass@1 and pass@16 and all reasoning budgets, hallucinations rise in step, training for 3–5 epochs (same diversity, no singletons) erases the trend, and monofacts from another domain help only when in-domain data is also present.

论文 arXiv:2611.03617 X 原帖 · @fly51fly

items.title: 编码 agent 的 harness 连续进化会严重遗忘：换一个任务类型再进化 5 轮，旧任务成绩可以掉光 / Coding-Agent Harnesses Forget Badly Under Continual Evolution: Five Rounds on a New Task Type Can Wipe Out the Old One
items.summary: 让编码 agent 的 harness 先在一类任务上自我进化、再换到另一类任务继续进化，会把前一类任务学到的东西大量抹掉，主要原因是进化器会把只适合当前数据集的产物检查和提交门槛写进 harness，这些规则随后会挡住旧任务上本来正确的提交。
items.content_html:
核心结论 让编码 agent 的 harness 先在一类任务上自我进化、再换到另一类任务继续进化，会把前一类任务学到的东西大量抹掉，主要原因是进化器会把只适合当前数据集的产物检查和提交门槛写进 harness，这些规则随后会挡住旧任务上本来正确的提交。

问题背景 AHE、Meta-Harness 这类 harness 自我进化方法都只在单一任务类型上评测，而真实的编码 agent 要在修 issue、写测试、加功能之间来回切换，没人检查过进化后的 harness 能否持续进化而不遗忘。

核心机制与实证 清华团队用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 在 Mini-SWE-Agent 上运行 AHE 和 Meta-Harness，覆盖 SWE-Bench、SWT-Bench、FeatureBench 三个数据集共 6 个跨任务方向：单任务进化有效（SWE-Bench 82%→96%（AHE）/94%（Meta-Harness），SWT-Bench 两者都到 100%，FeatureBench 提升超过 10 分），但从 SWE 转到 SWT 再进化 5 轮后，SWE-Bench 成绩下降 100%（AHE）和 98%（Meta-Harness），从 SWE 转到 Feature 时下降 29%（AHE）和 66%（Meta-Harness，94.0%→32.0%），任务越不相关遗忘越严重。作者分析了 520 条轨迹中由通过变失败的案例：87.1% 是验证冲突（为某个数据集定制的产物与提交门槛），8.2% 是工作流冲突，0.6% 是预算冲突。

Takeaway Evolving a coding agent's harness on one task type and then continuing on another wipes out much of what it learned on the first, mainly because the evolver writes dataset-specific artifact checks and submission gates into the harness that later block correct submissions on the old tasks.

Problem Harness self-evolution methods such as AHE and Meta-Harness are only evaluated on one task type at a time, while real coding agents switch between fixing issues, writing tests and adding features, so nobody had checked whether an evolved harness can keep evolving without forgetting.

How & Evidence A Tsinghua team runs AHE and Meta-Harness on Mini-SWE-Agent with DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 across SWE-Bench, SWT-Bench and FeatureBench in six cross-task directions: single-task evolution works (SWE-Bench 82% → 96% with AHE and 94% with Meta-Harness, both reach 100% on SWT-Bench, and FeatureBench gains over 10 points), but after five rounds of continuing from SWE to SWT, SWE-Bench performance drops 100% (AHE) and 98% (Meta-Harness), and going from SWE to Feature it drops 29% (AHE) and 66% (Meta-Harness, 94.0% → 32.0%), with forgetting worse between less related tasks. Analyzing pass-to-fail cases across 520 trajectories, 87.1% are verification conflicts (artifact and submission-gate rules tailored to one dataset), 8.2% workflow conflicts and 0.6% budget conflicts.

论文 arXiv:2611.03219 GitHub: THU-Agent/continual-harness-evolution X 原帖 · @pryzmat_tech

items.title: Strategist：把推理策略写成可复用的代码蓝图并存进共享库，策略设计从此可以跨任务积累 / Strategist: Writing Inference Strategies as Reusable Code Blueprints in a Shared Library Makes Strategy Design Cumulative Across Tasks
items.summary: 让元 agent 把推理策略写成可互相调用的代码、并把每个候选都存进跨任务共享的库，可以在更低成本下追平人工挑选的最佳基线，而起作用的主要是这个库：去掉库后 BBH 从 85.0 掉到 31.0。
items.content_html:
核心结论 让元 agent 把推理策略写成可互相调用的代码、并把每个候选都存进跨任务共享的库，可以在更低成本下追平人工挑选的最佳基线，而起作用的主要是这个库：去掉库后 BBH 从 85.0 掉到 31.0。

问题背景 把模型调用变成答案的推理策略（prompt、推理流程、多 agent 工作流）至今仍是逐个任务手写的；ADAS、AFlow 等自动搜索方法也只针对单个任务优化，一个任务上学到的东西不会带到下一个任务。

核心机制与实证 Strategist（Princeton、Meta）用冻结的 GPT-6（通过 Codex CLI）当策略设计者，任务模型是冻结的 Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B（开或关思考）；每个策略是共享同一接口的可执行“Strategy Blueprint”，在 10 轮迭代中每轮检索相关和多样的蓝图、写 5 个候选、在开发集上跑并读轨迹，再把所有候选连同准确率和成本存回库。在 30 个基准上对比 18 种基线（108 个单元），它在 24 个上胜出，平均准确率 74.0%→74.7%、成本低 39%；在 10 个留出基准上只靠检索、不再搜索，就在 8 个上胜过最强基线（77.8%→81.4%），策略不改一行迁到 GPT-5 和 Gemini-2.5 仍有效；需要注意平均准确率只高 0.7 分，部分“胜出”是同准确率更省成本，而且最终选出的策略在隐藏集上比基线高 4.3 分、到测试集只剩 0.7 分，说明挑选有运气成分。

Takeaway Having a meta-agent write inference strategies as code that other strategies can call, and keeping every candidate in a library shared across tasks, matches the best hand-picked baseline at much lower cost, and the library is what does the work: without it BBH falls from 85.0 to 31.0.

Problem The inference strategy that turns model calls into an answer (prompts, reasoning procedures, multi-agent workflows) is still hand-written per task, and automated search methods such as ADAS and AFlow also optimize one task at a time, so nothing learned on one task carries to the next.

How & Evidence Strategist (Princeton, Meta) uses a frozen GPT-6 through the Codex CLI as the strategy designer over frozen Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B task models (thinking on or off); each strategy is an executable Strategy Blueprint with one shared interface, and over 10 iterations it retrieves related and diverse blueprints, writes 5 candidates, runs them on a dev set, reads the traces and stores every candidate with its accuracy and cost. Against 18 baselines (108 cells) on 30 benchmarks it wins 24, moving average accuracy from 74.0% to 74.7% at 39% lower cost; on 10 held-out benchmarks retrieval alone with no search beats the strongest baseline on 8 (77.8% → 81.4%), and strategies moved unchanged to GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5 still beat the baselines; caveats are that the average gain is only 0.7 points, some wins are equal accuracy at lower cost, and the chosen strategy was 4.3 points above baseline on the hidden split but only 0.7 on test, so selection involves luck.

论文 arXiv:2611.03618 X 原帖 · @Zen_with_AI X 原帖（结果）

items.title: RSIGym 递归模式：让模型自己当研究员改进自己，目前还滚不起来 / RSIGym Recursive Mode: Letting a Model Act as Its Own Researcher Doesn't Compound Yet
items.summary: 让模型自己当研究员、训练自己的权重和 harness 目前还不能形成复利：Qwen3.8-27B 在 6 个开发任务上看着有提升，但它选出的系统在全部 37 个 SkillsBench 任务上从 56.66% 变成 56.26%，因为小开发集上的提升没有泛化；相比之下，前沿模型当研究员改进另一个目标模型能补上约 48% 的差距。
items.content_html:
核心结论 让模型自己当研究员、训练自己的权重和 harness 目前还不能形成复利：Qwen3.8-27B 在 6 个开发任务上看着有提升，但它选出的系统在全部 37 个 SkillsBench 任务上从 56.66% 变成 56.26%，因为小开发集上的提升没有泛化；相比之下，前沿模型当研究员改进另一个目标模型能补上约 48% 的差距。

问题背景 大多数 RSI 实验都是固定的研究员 agent 去改进另一个目标系统，而真正的递归自我改进要求改进后的系统成为下一轮的研究员。

核心机制与实证 RSIGym（Evolvent AI）把数据生成、LoRA 训练（Tinker）、评测（Harbor/E2B）和沙盒都做成带预算的服务，新加的 recurse 脚本 让每轮提交的 harness 和 checkpoint 成为下一轮的研究员，从继承的状态继续训练，rollout 只来自自己这条谱系，/workspace/memory 跨轮保留。主实验中每次运行 500 美元预算、从 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 出发，Opus 5 的 RSI-Index 为 0.4809，30 次 Joint 运行中 29 次有提升，只改 harness 时 Opus 5 把 Terminal-Bench 从 30.34% 提到 40.82%；但每个配置只跑一次，最终评测复用了开发期能接触到的任务。

Takeaway Having a model act as its own researcher, training its own weights and harness, does not compound yet: Qwen3.8-27B looked better on a six-task dev probe, but the system it selected went from 56.66% to 56.26% on all 37 SkillsBench tasks because the small dev-set gain didn't generalize, whereas frontier models acting as researchers on a separate target close about 48% of the gap.

Problem Most RSI experiments have a fixed researcher agent improve a separate target system, while true recursive self-improvement needs the improved system to become the next round's researcher.

How & Evidence RSIGym (Evolvent AI) exposes data generation, LoRA training (Tinker), evaluation (Harbor/E2B) and sandboxes as budgeted services, and its new recurse script makes each round's submitted harness and checkpoint the next round's researcher, continuing training from the inherited state with rollouts only from its own lineage and /workspace/memory carried between rounds. In the main study ($500 per run, starting from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base), Opus 5 leads with an RSI-Index of 0.4809, 29 of 30 Joint runs improve, and in a harness-only run Opus 5 lifts Terminal-Bench from 30.34% to 40.82%; each configuration ran once and final evaluations reuse tasks seen during development.

GitHub: evolvent-ai/RSIGym 论文 arXiv:2610.10310 X 原帖 · @FanqingMengAI X 原帖（发布）

items.title: 自动科研 agent 把 AlphaFold 3 当实验仪器，为每个复合物重新设计 MSA，比统一配方更准 / An Autoresearch Agent Treats AlphaFold 3 as an Instrument and Redesigns Each Complex's MSA, Beating Fixed Recipes
items.summary: 把冻结的 AlphaFold 3 当作黑箱实验仪器、只靠它自己的置信度信号为每个目标重新设计 MSA 的自动科研 agent，能胜过统一的 MSA 配方，因为最佳的序列深度和跨链配对确实因目标而异；但置信度不是完美的裁判，最后挑选时会还回约 41% 已找到的提升。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把冻结的 AlphaFold 3 当作黑箱实验仪器、只靠它自己的置信度信号为每个目标重新设计 MSA 的自动科研 agent，能胜过统一的 MSA 配方，因为最佳的序列深度和跨链配对确实因目标而异；但置信度不是完美的裁判，最后挑选时会还回约 41% 已找到的提升。

问题背景 AF3 预测蛋白复合物的效果取决于 MSA 的内容、深度和跨链配对，但现有流程对所有目标套用同一配方（尽量加深、按物种配对），连跨链配对对 AF3 是否有帮助都有争议。

核心机制与实证 上海交大团队的 agent 针对每个目标提出生物学假设、分析并重组 MSA 的行与配对（包括刻意不配对），只用 ipTM、PAE 等无标签置信度反复迭代；在 AF3 训练截止后发布的 FoldBench-v1、FoldBench-v2、HD439 共 1,015 个界面上，它在每个基准上都胜过 AF3 默认流程和固定配方，跨物种异源复合物 DockQ 从 0.465 升到 0.612（FoldBench）、0.482 升到 0.562（HD439），平均少用 60% 的 MSA 序列。在 278 个 FBv1 界面上，最好的测试方案平均比默认高 0.035 DockQ，但按置信度挑选后只剩 0.020（还回 41.0%），而用真实 DockQ 反馈时这个挑选损失几乎为零，说明反馈质量是主要瓶颈。

Takeaway An autoresearch agent that treats a frozen AlphaFold 3 as a black-box instrument and redesigns each target's MSA using only AF3's own confidence signals beats uniform MSA recipes, because the best depth and cross-chain pairing really differ per target, but confidence is an imperfect judge, so the final pick gives back about 41% of the improvement it found.

Problem AF3's protein-complex predictions depend on MSA content, depth and cross-chain pairing, yet current pipelines apply one recipe to every target (maximize depth, pair by species), and even whether cross-chain pairing helps AF3 is disputed.

How & Evidence The Shanghai Jiao Tong team's agent forms biological hypotheses for each target, analyzes and reorganizes MSA rows and pairing (including deliberate non-pairing), and iterates using only label-free confidence such as ipTM and PAE; on 1,015 interfaces from FoldBench-v1, FoldBench-v2 and HD439, all released after AF3's training cutoff, it beats AF3's default pipeline and fixed recipes on every benchmark, lifts inter-species heteromer DockQ from 0.465 to 0.612 (FoldBench) and 0.482 to 0.562 (HD439), and uses about 60% fewer MSA sequences. On 278 FBv1 interfaces the best tested proposal averages 0.035 DockQ above default but the confidence-based pick keeps only 0.020 (giving back 41.0%), while with ground-truth DockQ feedback that selection loss is near zero, so feedback quality is the main bottleneck.

论文 arXiv:2611.03183 项目页 X 原帖 · @BiologyAIDaily

items.title: Lineage Is Memory：反思式优化器的收益主要来自“继承父代”，而不是更宽的反馈 / Lineage Is Memory: reflective optimizers gain mostly from inheriting the parent, not from wider feedback
items.summary: 在 GEPA 这类反思式 prompt/代码优化器里，大部分提升只是因为每轮都在“当前最优存活候选”上继续改、而不是从 seed 重来：保留下来的版本记住了已学到的规则，并把已解决的样例挤出下一轮失败列表；给 proposer 看更多失败或换更大的 proposer 几乎没有额外收益。
items.content_html:
核心结论 在 GEPA 这类反思式 prompt/代码优化器里，大部分提升只是因为每轮都在“当前最优存活候选”上继续改、而不是从 seed 重来：保留下来的版本记住了已学到的规则，并把已解决的样例挤出下一轮失败列表；给 proposer 看更多失败或换更大的 proposer 几乎没有额外收益。

问题背景 近期反思式优化器都在扩大 proposer 每轮看到的反馈（聚类全部错误、定向 minibatch、更大的 proposer 模型），但这些方法只在保留谱系（lineage）的搜索里测试过，因此无法区分收益来自更宽的反馈还是来自继承父代。

核心机制与实证 作者在 9 个 prompt 与程序合成任务上做了 1,750 次预注册运行，交叉比较“继承父代 vs 重置为 seed”与五种反馈披露方式：继承在 gpt-4.1-mini 上带来 +23.8 分、在 claude-haiku-5-5 上 +22.2 分，只给父代看 4 条原始失败就胜过“重置 + 全部失败的聚类摘要”（领先 15.7 分），把 proposer 升级到 gpt-4.1 在重置条件下没有明显增益，而 gpt-4.1 下继承带来 +38.0 分。在 Banking77 上，只加一句“把反馈里的领域事实写进 prompt”的指令，就让 parent-first 从 37.2% 升到 85.6%，token 成本仅为 GEPA 的 43%，而在 GEPA 自身中反思只占 2–15% 的 token，验证与 minibatch 门控占了其余 85–98%；局限是 7 个主任务中有 5 个是通过隐藏规则构造的（偏向累积），且同一句指令让 BBH-STE 下降 6.1 分。

Takeaway In reflective prompt and code optimizers like GEPA, most of the gain comes simply from editing the best surviving candidate instead of restarting from the seed, because each kept revision stores the rules already learned and pushes solved cases out of the next failure list; showing the proposer more failures or using a bigger proposer adds little on top.

Problem Recent reflective optimizers widen what the proposer sees each round (clustering all errors, targeted minibatches, larger proposer models), but they are only ever tested inside lineage-preserving search, so nobody can tell whether the gain comes from wider feedback or from inheriting the parent.

How & Evidence Across 1,750 pre-registered runs on nine prompt and program-synthesis tasks, the authors cross parent inheritance against seed reset with five feedback-disclosure schemes: inheritance adds +23.8 points on gpt-4.1-mini and +22.2 on claude-haiku-5-5, showing just four raw failures to the parent beats seed reset with a clustered summary of every failure by +15.7 points, and upgrading the proposer to gpt-4.1 gives no clear gain under reset while inheritance under gpt-4.1 adds +38.0 points. On Banking77 one added sentence telling the proposer to carry domain facts from feedback into the prompt lifts parent-first from 37.2% to 85.6% at 43% of GEPA's token cost, while in GEPA itself reflection is only 2–15% of tokens and validation plus minibatch gating burn the other 85–98%; caveats: five of seven primary tasks are built by withholding rules, which favors accumulation, and the same sentence costs 6.1 points on BBH-STE.

items.title: h1：自动定理证明里的“苦涩教训”——简单 ReAct 循环 + 高效 Lean 接口追平或超过专用工作流 / h1: a taste of the bitter lesson in theorem proving, where a simple ReAct loop with an efficient Lean interface matches or beats specialized workflows
items.summary: 在形式化定理证明中，只给前沿模型一个高效的 Lean 接口、靠验证器反馈让它持续迭代的简单循环，在同模型、相近成本下追平或超过手工设计的分解与多智能体工作流，因为模型自身推理会随测试时算力扩展，而决定算力能否便宜地变成证明的是接口，不是工作流。
items.content_html:
核心结论 在形式化定理证明中，只给前沿模型一个高效的 Lean 接口、靠验证器反馈让它持续迭代的简单循环，在同模型、相近成本下追平或超过手工设计的分解与多智能体工作流，因为模型自身推理会随测试时算力扩展，而决定算力能否便宜地变成证明的是接口，不是工作流。

问题背景 形式化证明 harness 越来越多地在模型外层规定规划、分解与编排，但其增益常与更强模型或更多算力混在一起，因此不清楚在同等预算下它们是否真的优于一个高效的简单循环。

核心机制与实证 h1 让模型在 ReAct 循环里编辑一个持久的 Lean 文件，配有编译器反馈、搜索工具和外部验证器（SafeVerify），失败时由反思 LLM 压缩上下文进入下一轮：用 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 FATE-X 上 90/100、FC100-solved 78/100、IMO 2026 六题全解，GPT-5.5 解出 PutnamBench 672 题中的 670 题，并解决了 8 个 Formal Conjectures 开放问题（含 Erdős 138 与 337 的变体）。消融说明接口细节仍然关键：同为 Gemini 3 Flash、$20 预算，AxProverBase 在 Putnam100 上解 18 题而 h1 解 69 题；原生 Claude Code（Opus 4.8）在 FATE-X 上 63 题，接入 h1 的 prompt 与 Lean 工具（MCP）后 73 题，h1 本身 83 题；去掉搜索工具、REPL 与语言服务器则 Putnam100 从 69 降到 49；作者团队表示他们最初做的非对称 self-play 在基线 harness 调好后增益消失，707 道对比题中只有 2 题是专用工作流解出而 h1 没解出。

Takeaway For formal theorem proving, a simple loop that gives a frontier model an efficient Lean interface and keeps it going on verifier feedback matches or beats hand-designed decomposition and multi-agent workflows at the same model and similar cost, because the model's own reasoning scales with test-time compute while the interface, not the workflow, decides how cheaply that compute turns into proofs.

Problem Formal-proving harnesses increasingly prescribe planning, decomposition and orchestration around the model, but their gains are often confounded with stronger models or more compute, so it is unclear whether they beat an efficient simple loop under the same budget.

How & Evidence h1 lets the model edit a persistent Lean file in a ReAct loop with compiler feedback, search tools and an external validator (SafeVerify), and on rejection a reflection LLM compacts the transcript for the next round: with GPT-5.6 Sol it scores 90/100 on FATE-X, 78/100 on FC100-solved and solves all six IMO 2026 problems, GPT-5.5 solves 670 of 672 PutnamBench problems, and it settled eight open Formal Conjectures problems including variants of Erdős 138 and 337. Ablations show the interface still matters: with the same Gemini 3 Flash and a $20 budget AxProverBase solves 18 Putnam100 problems against 69 for h1, native Claude Code with Opus 4.8 solves 63 FATE-X problems, 73 with h1's prompt and Lean tools via MCP and 83 inside h1, and removing the search tools, REPL and language server drops Putnam100 from 69 to 49; the team says the asymmetric self-play they started with lost its gains once baseline harnesses were tuned, and in only 2 of 707 compared problems did a specialized workflow solve something h1 did not.

论文 arXiv:2610.35962 X 原帖 · @KempeLab 作者主帖 @SkanderMoalla

items.title: Weight-Space Programming：前沿 LLM 不用梯度直接读写神经网络权重 / Weight-Space Programming: frontier LLMs read and write neural network weights without gradients
items.summary: 前沿模型已经能通过推理“各部分在算什么”来直接修改另一个网络的权重，但最强的演示是在移除障碍而非增加能力：删掉一个导致循环的方向，让 Qwen3.5-0.8B 能把本来会做的题做完，而同样方法对一个不循环的小模型几乎无效。
items.content_html:
核心结论 前沿模型已经能通过推理“各部分在算什么”来直接修改另一个网络的权重，但最强的演示是在移除障碍而非增加能力：删掉一个导致循环的方向，让 Qwen3.5-0.8B 能把本来会做的题做完，而同样方法对一个不循环的小模型几乎无效。

问题背景 LLM 已被用来优化 prompt、harness 和训练代码，但权重一直交给基于梯度的优化器，因为人类无法手改权重；问题是一个原样使用的通用模型能否不靠梯度和训练循环直接读写权重。

核心机制与实证 在 MIT CSAIL 博客的实验中，GPT-6 Astra 仅凭原始权重说出四个同结构 PPO 策略各自训练的游戏，一次回复改动 3.5% 权重就让卡住的 Kinetix 小车策略从 0% 到 1,024 局全部成功，并在 Python kernel + 50 次前向的预算下，从 Qwen3.5-0.8B 第 15 和 19 层 MLP 的 131,072 个权重（0.016%）中减去一个循环方向，使 MATH-500 从 7.9% 升到 48.1%、GSM8K 从 13.8% 到 67.1%、IFEval 从 21.0% 到 62.3%，触达 token 上限的比例从 93% 降到 33%。作者自述对很少循环的 Gemma 3 270M 最多只提升约 1 分；后续讨论中 @AlexKrentsel 称已复现，@JustinAngel 则指出在一个新物理任务上 Claude 先在思维链里做了 20 多分钟数学推导再写权重，因此这是推理而非对权重的“天生理解”。

Takeaway Frontier models can now edit another network's weights directly by reasoning about what its parts compute, but the strongest demo removed an obstacle rather than adding skill: deleting one looping direction let Qwen3.5-0.8B finish answers it could already work out, and the same approach barely moved a small model that does not loop.

Problem LLMs already optimize prompts, harnesses and training code, but weights have stayed with gradient-based optimizers because humans cannot hand-edit them, so the question is whether a general-purpose model, used as is, can read and write weights without gradients or training loops.

How & Evidence In MIT CSAIL blog experiments GPT-6 Astra named which game each of four identically shaped PPO policies was trained on from raw weights, edited 3.5% of a stuck Kinetix car policy in one reply to go from 0% to success in all 1,024 episodes, and, with a Python kernel and 50 forward passes, subtracted a looping direction from 131,072 MLP weights (0.016%) in layers 15 and 19 of Qwen3.5-0.8B, raising MATH-500 from 7.9% to 48.1%, GSM8K from 13.8% to 67.1% and IFEval from 21.0% to 62.3% while token-limit hits fell from 93% to 33%. The authors report that Gemma 3 270M, which rarely loops, moved by about a point at most, and in follow-ups @AlexKrentsel says he reproduced the results while @JustinAngel argues that on a new physics task Claude spent 20+ minutes of chain-of-thought math before writing weights, so it is reasoning rather than an innate grasp of weights.

博客 GitHub: RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs X 原帖 · @rikiyatakehi 复现帖 @AlexKrentsel 质疑帖 @JustinAngel

items.title: DISCERN：AI 科学家能否从可信证据走到有效、新颖的假设 / DISCERN: can AI scientists get from trustworthy evidence to valid, novel hypotheses
items.summary: 研究智能体总分看起来不错，但几乎从不能把假设生成完整做对，原因是它们判断不了该信哪些证据：会拒绝可靠数据、在结论里丢掉已知局限，并在证据与先验冲突时要么全部放弃、要么硬给假设。
items.content_html:
核心结论 研究智能体总分看起来不错，但几乎从不能把假设生成完整做对，原因是它们判断不了该信哪些证据：会拒绝可靠数据、在结论里丢掉已知局限，并在证据与先验冲突时要么全部放弃、要么硬给假设。

问题背景 自动化科研的基准通常分开评测分析完成度或假设生成，并不检验可信证据是否真正支撑了有效且新颖的结论。

核心机制与实证 DISCERN 基于真实公开数据构建 8 个生命科学方向的 203 个任务，分三级（数据完整性；带混杂和工具陷阱的分析验证；对抗审查下的假设生成与修订，含证据与既有预期冲突的反事实案例），8 个模型的满分率从 Level 1 的 60.8% 降到 Level 2 的 34.2% 和 Level 3 的 0.6%。GPT-6 Astra 总分最高（78.1），GPT-5.6 Sol 75.8、Claude Opus 5 75.6，但干净对照中只有 64 次里的 19 次正确接受了可靠数据，Astra 在所有反事实案例上弃权而 Kimi 在 92.3% 的案例中硬给假设，Sol 以约三分之一的 token（14.06M 对 42.24M）追平 Opus。

Takeaway Research agents look strong in aggregate but almost never get hypothesis generation fully right, because they misjudge which evidence to trust: they reject sound data, drop known limitations from conclusions, and either always abstain or always press on when evidence conflicts with their priors.

Problem Benchmarks for automated research usually score analysis completion or hypothesis generation separately, so they do not test whether trustworthy evidence actually supports valid and novel claims.

How & Evidence DISCERN builds 203 tasks over eight life-science tracks on real public datasets in three levels (data integrity, analysis verification under confounds and tool traps, and hypothesis generation and revision under adversarial review, including counterfactual cases where evidence conflicts with established expectations), and across eight models perfect scores fall from 60.8% at Level 1 to 34.2% at Level 2 and 0.6% at Level 3. GPT-6 Astra tops the aggregate (78.1) ahead of GPT-5.6 Sol (75.8) and Claude Opus 5 (75.6), yet only 19 of 64 clean-control evaluations correctly accept sound data, Astra abstains on every eligible counterfactual case while Kimi submits a hypothesis in 92.3% of them, and Sol matches Opus with about a third of the tokens (14.06M against 42.24M).

论文 arXiv:2609.33357 项目主页 X 原帖 · @NanHuang99

items.title: Embodied Turing Machines：纯代码机器人策略 + 编码智能体闭环自我改进 / Embodied Turing Machines: code-only robot policies improved by coding agents in a closed loop
items.summary: 把机器人策略完全写成基于显式测量状态的代码，再让编码智能体离线持续改进共享代码库，在 42 个双臂任务上大幅超过模型在环的策略，因为每次修改都可检查、可并行测试、可跨任务复用，不过论文结果全部来自仿真。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把机器人策略完全写成基于显式测量状态的代码，再让编码智能体离线持续改进共享代码库，在 42 个双臂任务上大幅超过模型在环的策略，因为每次修改都可检查、可并行测试、可跨任务复用，不过论文结果全部来自仿真。

问题背景 机器人策略通常把 VLA 或 VLM 驱动的智能体 harness 放在控制环里，状态是隐式的、失败难以追踪和修复，这并不是递归自我改进的好载体。

核心机制与实证 COAP 用代码变量从 RGB 相机和本体感知中追踪机器人、物体、关系和任务状态，由 Opus 5.5 Max 编码智能体在固定规则下（禁止针对单局的 hack、测试时不用 oracle 状态）闭环开发共享代码库，并像广度优先搜索一样在并行分支中探索决策变体；在 RoboDojo 的 42 个双臂任务上成功率 70.24%，此前最佳为 31.38%，新任务 83% 的代码来自代码库。论文说明全部结果在仿真中、依赖基准提供的相机参数与物体尺寸，失败中 62% 来自感知与接触状态错误、37% 来自代码逻辑不完整，随机布局下成功率为 54.1%（标准布局 77.3%）；该工作 10 月发布，今日被再次转发。

Takeaway Writing a robot policy entirely as code over explicitly measured state, and letting coding agents keep improving a shared library offline, far outperforms model-in-the-loop policies on 42 bimanual tasks because every change is inspectable, testable in parallel and reusable across tasks, although the paper's results are all in simulation.

Problem Robot policies usually keep a VLA or a VLM-driven agent harness in the control loop, which leaves state implicit and failures hard to trace or fix, a poor substrate for recursive self-improvement.

How & Evidence COAP tracks robot, object, relation and task state as code variables from RGB cameras and proprioception, and an Opus 5.5 Max coding agent develops a shared library in a closed loop under fixed rules (no single-episode hacks, no oracle state at test time), exploring decision variants in parallel branches like a breadth-first search; on RoboDojo's 42 bimanual tasks it reaches 70.24% success against 31.38% for the best prior method, with 83% of new-task code coming from the library. The paper notes that all results are in simulation and use the benchmark's camera parameters and object sizes, that 62% of failures come from perception and contact-state errors and 37% from incomplete code logic, and that randomized layouts reach 54.1% against 77.3% on standard ones; the work came out in October and resurfaced today.

论文 arXiv:2610.12369 X 原帖 · @ropedia_ai 今日转发 @VisiveAI

items.title: CoHARL：在 RL 训练中让策略和一群可执行 harness 一起进化，比只搜 harness 或只练模型都强 / CoHARL: Co-Evolving the Policy and a Population of Executable Harnesses Beats Searching Harnesses or Training Weights Alone
items.summary: 把 harness 搜索放进 RL 训练循环、让策略和一群 harness 同时进化，比先搜好 harness 再训练、或者固定 harness 只训练模型都好，因为每个 harness 都会改变策略看到的数据和奖励，只有边训练边换，两者才能互相适配。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把 harness 搜索放进 RL 训练循环、让策略和一群 harness 同时进化，比先搜好 harness 再训练、或者固定 harness 只训练模型都好，因为每个 harness 都会改变策略看到的数据和奖励，只有边训练边换，两者才能互相适配。

问题背景 给编码 agent 找更好 harness 的方法（如 Meta-Harness）都把模型冻住，而 agentic RL 又都在一个固定 harness 里训练，于是模型和 harness 之间的适配从来没被一起优化过。

核心机制与实证 CoHARL（UNC Chapel Hill、RIKEN、Cisco）在训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（rank-32 LoRA，类 GRPO）时维护最多 8 个可执行 harness：由 Claude Opus 4.7 担任的 proposer 读取成功/失败轨迹和准确率–成本 Pareto 存档，每轮提出最多 2 个新 harness，调度器再在 harness 之间分配 rollout；在 SWE-rebench 110 个留出任务上，基线 17.3%、Meta-Harness 21.2%、普通 GRPO 20.3%，CoHARL 达到 27.6%，不做适配直接迁到 SWE-bench Verified 为 59.8%（对比 44.2/52.0/49.8%），Terminal-Bench 2.0 为 36.8%。在 30 步的对照消融中，完整方法 25.5%，固定 harness 和去掉存档都是 20.0%，先搜索再 RL 为 22.7%，只保留单个 harness 交替替换反而降到 19.1%（换掉唯一的 harness 会突然改变数据和奖励分布）；作者也指出只试了一个策略模型、每个设置只跑一次、没有置信区间，也没有完整的算力对比。

Takeaway Putting harness search inside the RL loop so the policy and a population of harnesses evolve together beats searching a harness first and then training, or training on one fixed harness, because each harness changes the data and reward the policy sees and the two only fit each other when they change together.

Problem Methods that search for better coding-agent harnesses (such as Meta-Harness) freeze the model, while agentic RL always trains inside one fixed harness, so how well the model and harness fit each other is never optimized jointly.

How & Evidence CoHARL (UNC Chapel Hill, RIKEN, Cisco) trains Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (rank-32 LoRA, GRPO-style) while keeping up to 8 executable harnesses: a Claude Opus 4.7 proposer reads success and failure traces plus a Pareto archive of accuracy and cost, proposes up to 2 new harnesses per round, and a scheduler splits rollouts across harnesses; on 110 held-out SWE-rebench tasks the base model scores 17.3%, Meta-Harness 21.2%, plain GRPO 20.3% and CoHARL 27.6%, and it reaches 59.8% on SWE-bench Verified without adaptation (vs 44.2/52.0/49.8%) and 36.8% on Terminal-Bench 2.0. In a matched 30-step ablation the full method reaches 25.5%, a fixed harness and no archive both drop to 20.0%, search-then-RL gets 22.7%, and keeping a single harness that is swapped out drops to 19.1% (replacing the only harness abruptly shifts the data and reward distribution); the authors note they tried one policy model, ran each setting once, report no confidence intervals and give no full compute comparison.

论文 arXiv:2610.36469 X 原帖 · @lokiscripter

items.title: TinyAstral：先让冻结的大模型把机器人 harness 进化好，再蒸馏给 4B 小模型，效果几乎不掉 / TinyAstral: Evolve a Frozen Teacher's Robot Harness First, Then Distill It into a 4B Model with Almost No Loss
items.summary: 在冻结的 180B 教师上进化出来的机器人 harness 可以几乎无损地转给 4B 小模型，因为感知、抓取几何和运动规划都由 harness 负责，小模型只需学会教师的“做什么”和出错后怎么恢复。
items.content_html:
核心结论 在冻结的 180B 教师上进化出来的机器人 harness 可以几乎无损地转给 4B 小模型，因为感知、抓取几何和运动规划都由 harness 负责，小模型只需学会教师的“做什么”和出错后怎么恢复。

问题背景 用大视觉语言模型通过 harness 操作机器人效果好，但部署太贵；而 harness 自我改进（RSI）的收益以前都绑在那个大模型上，不清楚能不能带到便宜的小模型里。

核心机制与实证 TinyAstral（华为诺亚等）第一阶段冻结 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（180B）教师，由前沿 LLM agent 读失败轨迹、按十类失败归因并提出工具、反馈、记忆和恢复逻辑的修改，只有通过预先登记的配对统计检验才接受，RoboTwin 成功率从 33.4% 升到 63.6%，且对 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 等其他冻结规划器也有效；第二阶段冻结最终 harness，收集含推理和恢复分支的教师轨迹，加上离线真机监督，蒸馏 0.8B–4B 学生。TinyAstral-4B 在 RoboTwin、Guava、LIBERO-PRO 上为 62.8/93.6/78.3%（教师 63.6/94.7/80.0%），在四个 harness 版本上训练的学生（36.2→62.8%）都贴近对应教师，在三个未见基准上接近同一 harness 里的 552B 规划器，每回合加速器时间约为教师的五分之一（25.3 对 123.8 加速器·秒），并在真实 SO-ARM101 机械臂上闭环运行；同 harness 下未训练的 4B 模型失败时，63% 是把调用预算耗尽。

Takeaway A robot harness evolved around a frozen 180B teacher carries over almost losslessly to a 4B student, because the harness handles perception, grasp geometry and motion planning, so the small model only has to learn the teacher's decisions about what to do and how to recover from failures.

Problem Large vision-language planners driving robots through a harness work well but are expensive to deploy, and past harness self-improvement (RSI) gains were tied to the large model, leaving it unclear whether they carry into a cheap small one.

How & Evidence TinyAstral (Huawei Noah's Ark and others) first freezes a Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (180B) teacher while frontier LLM agents read its failure trajectories, assign them to ten failure classes and propose changes to tools, feedback, memory and recovery logic, accepting an edit only if it passes a pre-registered paired statistical test; RoboTwin success rises from 33.4% to 63.6%, and the evolved harness also helps other frozen planners such as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. It then freezes the final harness, collects teacher trajectories with reasoning and recovery branches plus offline real-robot supervision, and distills 0.8B–4B students: TinyAstral-4B scores 62.8/93.6/78.3% on RoboTwin, Guava and LIBERO-PRO (teacher 63.6/94.7/80.0%), students trained at four harness versions (36.2→62.8%) track their teachers, it comes close to a 552B planner in the same harness on three unseen benchmarks, uses about one fifth of the teacher's accelerator time per episode (25.3 vs 123.8 accelerator-seconds), and runs closed-loop on a real SO-ARM101 arm; when the untrained 4B model fails in the same harness, 63% of the time it has run out of its call budget.

论文 arXiv:2610.41216 GitHub: Garfield-kh/TinyAstral X 原帖 · @GKehong

items.title: Selm：把技能进化当成“管理技能库”，验证门槛和退役机制比写出新技能更重要 / Selm: Treat Skill Evolution as Library Management, Where the Validation Gate and Retirement Matter More Than Writing New Skills
items.summary: 把 agent 技能当成一个有效用分、验证门槛和“墓地”的长期库来管理，比每轮直接改写技能效果好，因为逐轮改写会覆盖以后还有用的技能，也会让失败的技能继续被加载。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把 agent 技能当成一个有效用分、验证门槛和“墓地”的长期库来管理，比每轮直接改写技能效果好，因为逐轮改写会覆盖以后还有用的技能，也会让失败的技能继续被加载。

问题背景 现有技能进化方法（GEPA、SkillEvolver、Memento-Skills、Trace2Skill 等）把每次更新当作孤立的一轮编辑，不决定哪些技能该检索、该改、该留，跨任务的经验冲突时很容易互相覆盖。

核心机制与实证 Selm（中国人民大学等）给每个技能维护置信度和效用分（EMA），按相关性和历史效用检索技能，用按类别的 Map-Reduce 从轨迹生成增删改操作，新库只有在选择集上提分才被接受，并把反复失败的技能名放进 graveyard 防止被重新加回；在 SkillsBench、OfficeQA、SpreadsheetBench、LiveMath 上，以 Claude Opus 4.6 不加 harness 为例，SpreadsheetBench 从无技能 44.3% 升到 56.8%，SkillsBench soft 从 40.4% 升到 69.8%，在 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上也领先。消融中去掉验证门槛下降最多（56.5%→42.5%），去掉效用检索为 49.2%，去掉 graveyard 为 50.4%；但它并非处处最好（Claude Code harness 下 OfficeQA 73.1% 低于 EvoSkill 的 75.4%），graveyard 只按名字精确匹配，最多只测了 30 个技能。

Takeaway Managing agent skills as a long-lived library with utility scores, a validation gate and a graveyard works better than rewriting skills each round, because round-by-round edits overwrite skills that would help later tasks and let failed skills keep being loaded.

Problem Existing skill-evolution methods such as GEPA, SkillEvolver, Memento-Skills and Trace2Skill treat each update as an isolated edit and never decide which skills to retrieve, change or keep, so conflicting experience from different tasks easily overwrites itself.

How & Evidence Selm (Renmin University of China and others) keeps a confidence and an EMA utility score for every skill, retrieves skills by relevance and past utility, turns trajectories into add, edit and downvote operations with a per-category Map-Reduce, accepts a new library only if it raises the selection-set score, and puts repeatedly failing skill names in a graveyard so they are not re-added; across SkillsBench, OfficeQA, SpreadsheetBench and LiveMath with Claude Opus 4.6 and no harness, SpreadsheetBench rises from 44.3% with no skills to 56.8% and SkillsBench soft accuracy from 40.4% to 69.8%, and it also leads on DeepSeek-V4-Pro and Qwen3-30B-A3B. In ablations, removing the validation gate costs the most (56.5% → 42.5%), removing utility-aware retrieval gives 49.2% and removing the graveyard 50.4%; it is not best everywhere (73.1% vs EvoSkill's 75.4% on OfficeQA in the Claude Code harness), the graveyard only matches exact names, and it was tested with at most 30 skills.

论文 arXiv:2610.24630 X 原帖 · @DerekHJH9

items.title: Épi：跨会话持久记忆加固定验证尺子，自动科研拿下 120 项纪录，但对比 Codex 的优势主要来自速度 / Épi: Persistent Memory Plus a Fixed Verifier Yields 120 Autoresearch Records, Though Its Edge over Codex Comes Mostly from Speed
items.summary: 能跨多个模型会话持续推进、并把经验和死路记下来的科研 agent，能在一把预先固定的验证尺子下稳定刷新数学和优化纪录；但在算法编码对比中，它胜过 Codex 主要是程序跑得更快，而不是解更好。
items.content_html:
核心结论 能跨多个模型会话持续推进、并把经验和死路记下来的科研 agent，能在一把预先固定的验证尺子下稳定刷新数学和优化纪录；但在算法编码对比中，它胜过 Codex 主要是程序跑得更快，而不是解更好。

问题背景 一次研究常常超过单个模型会话能承载的工作量，agent 需要在会话之间保持状态、回到旧分支，并防止自己挑选证据、把刷分误当成进展。

核心机制与实证 Épi（Bake AI 等）把代码、产物和笔记存在持久文件系统里，在模型上下文之外保存分层记忆（经验与死路），用版本化分支保存各条方法路线，由另一个模型独立评审进展，并由隔离的验证器按预先固定的容差和最小增益判定是否算新纪录；它报告了 120 项纪录（12 类 20 个数值界、8 类 100 个构造），包括 n 皇后常数区间收窄约 84 倍、四次 Feigenbaum 吸引子维数的严格区间收窄 360 多万倍，以及 Tuza 猜想一个新情形的计算机辅助证明。在 30 个对双方都是新题的 FrontierOR 任务上，Épi-turbo 与 Codex 用同一模型 GPT-6-Astra、每题 20 美元预算，总分 53.96 对 51.21，成本为 64%，但平均质量项几乎相同（1.030 对 1.032），差距来自速度项（0.784 对 0.675），在 119 个可比实例中 Codex 解更好的有 61 个、Épi-turbo 只有 18 个，且每题只跑一次、没有显著性检验。

Takeaway A research agent that keeps going across many model sessions and records its lessons and dead ends can reliably set new math and optimization records under a verifier fixed in advance, but in the coding comparison it beats Codex mainly because its programs run faster, not because its solutions are better.

Problem A research investigation often needs more work than one model session can hold, so the agent must keep state between sessions, return to earlier branches, and avoid choosing its own evidence or mistaking score gaming for progress.

How & Evidence Épi (Bake AI and others) keeps code, artifacts and notes in a persistent filesystem, stores hierarchical memory of lessons and dead ends outside the model context, keeps each method line on a versioned branch, has a different model review progress independently, and lets an isolated verifier decide records under tolerances and a minimum gain fixed in advance; it reports 120 records (20 numerical bounds in 12 families, 100 constructions in 8), including an about 84-fold narrower interval for the n-queens constant, a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension, and a computer-assisted proof of a new case of Tuza's conjecture. On 30 FrontierOR tasks new to both systems, Épi-turbo and Codex use the same model (GPT-6-Astra) and a $20 budget per task, and Épi-turbo scores 53.96 vs 51.21 at 64% of the cost, but the mean quality term is nearly equal (1.030 vs 1.032) and the gap comes from the speed term (0.784 vs 0.675); of 119 comparable instances Codex has the better solution on 61 and Épi-turbo on 18, with one run per task and no significance test.

论文 arXiv:2610.24944 博客 GitHub: BakeLab/Epi-results X 原帖 · @Arindam_1729

items.title: Hyra 2.0：腾讯混元让自动科研从“刷题”转向“造工具”，agent 从头训练科学模型、升级芯片和量子码工具 / Hyra 2.0: Tencent Hunyuan Shifts Autoresearch from Solving Problems to Building Tools, with Agents Training Science Models from Scratch
items.summary: 让自动科研 agent 去造和升级可复用的工具（科学模型、证明工作流、验证器），比一道道刷开放问题更有复利，因为升级一件工具，所有用到它的下游任务都会受益。
items.content_html:
核心结论 让自动科研 agent 去造和升级可复用的工具（科学模型、证明工作流、验证器），比一道道刷开放问题更有复利，因为升级一件工具，所有用到它的下游任务都会受益。

问题背景 Hyra 1.0 之类“给 agent 一道有明确评判的难题、循环尝试”的路线已经能刷新纪录，但每次突破并不会让下一次研究更强；而研发工具需要持续数天到数周的设计、训练、评估和返工，单个越拉越长的 agent 会话很难管理。

核心机制与实证 Hyra 2.0 接入团队真实研发环境（企业微信、计算平台、代码仓库，大额算力需人工审批），分 Overall、Mission、Worker 三层，配持久化任务队列、Research Board、看不到执行者结论就先看原始证据的独立 Review Worker，以及按“观察 / 已验证 / 约定”分级的共享知识库 Books 和可复用 skill；腾讯自报的成果包括从头训练的 196 万参数逆折叠模型 HyInv（比 ProteinMPNN 快 57 倍、结构吻合更好）和 6.5 亿参数的 HyPLM-Flash（训练 token 为 ESM-2 650M 的 0.73 倍，12 个模型中推理最快、35 个任务平均排名第 3），量子码 [[488,123,22]]（kd²/n=122.0，比 qLDPC Challenge 原榜首高约 48%，并为 187 个条目中 178 个认证精确码距），香山处理器 SPEC CPU2006 每 GHz 得分 +5.79%、发现 10 个未上报 bug，以及与数学家核验的五维 Petty 等距点猜想证明。这些数字都来自腾讯自己的博客，HyInv/HyPLM 技术报告尚未发布，旋梯灵巧手 28.6% 的提速只在仿真中验证。

Takeaway Pointing autoresearch agents at building and upgrading reusable tools (science models, proof workflows, verifiers) compounds more than solving open problems one at a time, because upgrading one tool benefits every downstream task that uses it.

Problem Loops like Hyra 1.0 that hand an agent a well-scored hard problem and keep trying can already set records, but each breakthrough does not make the next study stronger, and building tools takes days to weeks of design, training, evaluation and rework that one ever-longer agent session cannot manage.

How & Evidence Hyra 2.0 plugs into the team's real R&D environment (WeCom, the compute platform and code repos, with human approval for large compute), splits work across Overall, Mission and Worker layers, and adds a persistent task queue, a Research Board, an independent Review Worker that sees raw evidence before the executor's conclusion, and a shared knowledge base, Books, graded as observation, verified or convention, plus reusable skills; Tencent's own reported results include HyInv, a 1.96M-parameter inverse-folding model trained from scratch that is 57x faster than ProteinMPNN with better structural fit, HyPLM-Flash (650M parameters, 0.73x ESM-2 650M's training tokens, fastest of 12 protein language models and 3rd on average across 35 tasks), the quantum code [[488,123,22]] (kd²/n = 122.0, about 48% above the previous qLDPC Challenge leader, plus exact distances certified for 178 of 187 leaderboard entries), +5.79% SPEC CPU2006 score per GHz and 10 unreported bugs on the XiangShan processor, and a mathematician-checked proof of Petty's equilateral-set conjecture in dimension 5. All numbers come from Tencent's own blog, the HyInv and HyPLM technical reports are not out yet, and the spiral-staircase hand's 28.6% speedup is simulation-only.

博客 GitHub: Tencent-Hunyuan/hyra-results X 原帖 · @TencentHunyuan X 原帖（评论）

items.title: R²Orch：编排器在自博弈中内化手写技能，部署时零技能仍胜过 PATS 与 FlowSteer / R²Orch: An Orchestrator That Internalizes Hand-Written Skills Through Self-Play Beats PATS and FlowSteer With Zero Skills at Deployment
items.summary: 学会设计多智能体工作流的编排器可以把手写技能内化、部署时完全不用它们，因为只有成对对照证明某个技能已不再有帮助时才会撤掉它，而自博弈课程会持续生成撤掉该技能后仍然可学的任务。
items.content_html:
核心结论 学会设计多智能体工作流的编排器可以把手写技能内化、部署时完全不用它们，因为只有成对对照证明某个技能已不再有帮助时才会撤掉它，而自博弈课程会持续生成撤掉该技能后仍然可学的任务。

问题背景 现有智能体编排方法要么在测试时依赖固定的手写技能和 scaffold，要么在静态任务集上训练，rollout 很快全对或全错，GRPO 的 advantage 信号随之塌缩。

核心机制与实证 R²Orch 让 Proposer 为 Director 出题，Director 编辑由冻结的 Qwen3.5-9B Worker 执行的智能体图；外层 Skill Withdrawal 在每个 rollout 组的一部分里隐藏一个技能，并在贝叶斯成对对比显示该技能不再有帮助时将其撤除，Recursive Learnability 则奖励那些撤掉该技能后 rollout 结果仍有分歧的任务。在零技能测试下（五次平均），Director 的 IID 平均准确率 89.79（PATS 86.00、FlowSteer 82.34、直接用 Qwen3.5-9B 61.35），OOD 78.79（PATS 76.13），AIME 2026 81.33（PATS 74.00）；固定 scaffold 时 ALFWorld 从 90.63 降到 77.81，按当前 scaffold 计算可学性则 AIME 降到 70.67，12 次撤除的后验均 ≤0.019，Director 不加修改迁移到另外 6 个 backbone 后 IID 差距从 25.7 分缩小到 6.4 分；不过初始技能仍需为每个数据集手工定制。

Takeaway An orchestrator that learns to design multi-agent workflows can internalize hand-written skills and drop them entirely at deployment, because a skill is retired only once a paired test shows it no longer helps, and the self-play curriculum keeps generating tasks that are still learnable without it.

Problem Agent-orchestration methods either depend on fixed hand-written skills and scaffolds at test time or train on static task sets whose rollouts quickly all succeed or all fail, collapsing the GRPO advantage signal.

How & Evidence R²Orch has a Proposer generate tasks for a Director that edits agent graphs executed by frozen Qwen3.5-9B Workers; an outer Skill Withdrawal step hides one skill from part of each rollout group and retires it once a Bayesian paired contrast shows it no longer helps, while Recursive Learnability rewards the Proposer for tasks whose rollouts still disagree with that skill withheld. Tested with zero skills (five-run mean), the Director reaches 89.79 average IID accuracy (PATS 86.00, FlowSteer 82.34, direct Qwen3.5-9B 61.35), 78.79 OOD (PATS 76.13) and 81.33 on AIME 2026 (PATS 74.00); fixing the scaffold drops ALFWorld from 90.63 to 77.81, scoring learnability on the current scaffold drops AIME to 70.67, all 12 withdrawals had posterior ≤0.019, and the Director transfers unchanged to 6 other backbones, narrowing their IID spread from 25.7 to 6.4 points, although initial skills are still hand-customized per dataset.

论文 arXiv:2610.22740 GitHub: beita6969/R2Orch X 原帖 · @HuggingPapers

items.title: RSI That Builds RSI：让改进者本身在研究者评判的外层循环里变强 / RSI That Builds RSI: Let the Improver Itself Get Better in an Outer Loop Judged by the Researcher
items.summary: Xi Zhang 认为当前多数“RSI”系统的改进者其实固定不变，改进者应当在由研究者评判的外层循环中变强，并提出用“新项目的循环是否起点更高、收敛更快”来检验这一点。
items.content_html:
核心结论 Xi Zhang 认为当前多数“RSI”系统的改进者其实固定不变，改进者应当在由研究者评判的外层循环中变强，并提出用“新项目的循环是否起点更高、收敛更快”来检验这一点。

问题背景 harness 演化循环会改进 Target 智能体的 recipe 和权重，但负责改进的 Conductor 本身不变，而且在同一份数据上搜索和打分时，“多试了几次”很容易被当成“学到了东西”。

核心机制与实证 该设计（面向 EvoScientist²）在每个项目内运行 EvoMachine：Conductor 根据 Judge 打分和运行日志改写 Target 的 recipe（system prompt、工具、子智能体），每隔几个版本由 Trainer 返回一个 LoRA adapter 和一个 Jev 风格的小型选择模型，且只有在 Conductor 从未见过的留出集上成立的版本才算进步；在所有项目之上，Super Session 从研究者的批准和纠正中学习如何设置、初始化和停止各个循环。这是一篇观点与设计文章，没有新实验：文中引用了一项重新评估（Terminal-Bench 2.1 上演化出的 harness 在同等预算下并不优于简单的 test-time scaling）、AIDE² 未定论的“点火测试”（0.780 对 0.782，各三个种子）以及 Sakana 的 MASS，并把外层循环的点火测试列为第一个要做的实验。

Takeaway Xi Zhang argues that most current “RSI” systems keep the improver fixed, that the improver should instead get better in an outer loop judged by the researcher, and that this can be tested by whether each new project's loop starts higher and converges faster.

Problem Harness-evolution loops improve a Target agent's recipe and weights while the Conductor doing the improving stays the same, and searching and scoring on the same data lets extra attempts pass for learning.

How & Evidence The design (for EvoScientist²) runs an EvoMachine inside each project, where a Conductor rewrites the Target's recipe (system prompt, tools, sub-agents) from Judge scores and run logs, every few versions a Trainer returns a LoRA adapter plus a small Jev-style choice model, and a version counts as progress only if it holds on a held-out split the Conductor never sees; above all projects a Super Session learns from the researcher's approvals and corrections how to set up, seed and stop loops. It is a position and design essay with no new experiments: it cites a re-evaluation finding an evolved harness no better than matched-budget test-time scaling on Terminal-Bench 2.1, AIDE²'s inconclusive ignition test (0.780 vs 0.782, three seeds each) and Sakana's MASS, and names an outer-loop ignition test as its first planned experiment.

博客 GitHub: EvoScientist/EvoScientist X 原帖 · @_xizhang

items.title: 协作 AI 智能体自主完成固态量子自旋实验：PI 智能体拒绝“通过但对照失败”的结果 / Collaborative AI Agents Run a Solid-State Quantum Spin Lab, With a PI Agent That Refused a Passing Run Whose Controls Failed
items.summary: 一组 LLM 智能体能端到端地完成真实的量子自旋实验，因为 PI 智能体持续否决弱想法，并拒绝接受对照失败的“通过”结果，从而揪出了开灯造成的信号漂移，最终实验才证实了推导出的定律。
items.content_html:
核心结论 一组 LLM 智能体能端到端地完成真实的量子自旋实验，因为 PI 智能体持续否决弱想法，并拒绝接受对照失败的“通过”结果，从而揪出了开灯造成的信号漂移，最终实验才证实了推导出的定律。

问题背景 自主科研系统大多停留在仿真或窄范围的优化上，尚不清楚智能体能否自己挑出值得做的问题、推导理论、在物理设备上做实验并给出诚实的结论。

核心机制与实证 六类智能体角色（proposers、PI、计算研究员、实验员、manager、reviewers）加一个安全智能体操作 NV 色心金刚石自旋系综：约 30 小时内 PI 否决了 75 个提案，前 17 批一个都没接受，直到 manager 排除反复出现的想法家族（此前 56 个提案中的 52 个），新的 9 个提案打开了 7 个新方向；PI 随后推导出精确的标定定律，证明最多 L 个脉冲的序列需要且只需要 L²+1 次标定（L=3 时从提案给出的上界 91 降到 10）。第一次实验通过了全部 10 条预先承诺的精度标准，却没通过全局相位和参考对照，原因是信号漂移（上午累计 +7.6%，开灯时还有一次 2.9% 的跳变），PI 维持“无定论”并在不放宽标准的前提下修订了方案；最终 6 小时实验（21,600 条一秒记录）通过全部标准和对照，测得目标对比度 (40.0±0.4)×10⁻³，与定律预测的 (39.7±1.3)×10⁻³ 一致，而插值方案预测为零；装置由人类搭建，安全上限也由人类设定。

Takeaway A team of LLM agents could run a real quantum-spin experiment end to end because a PI agent kept rejecting weak ideas and refused to accept a passing run whose controls failed, which exposed light-induced signal drift before the final run confirmed the derived law.

Problem Autonomous-science systems mostly work in simulation or on narrow optimization, and it is unclear whether agents can choose a worthwhile question, derive theory and run a physical experiment while reporting honest verdicts.

How & Evidence Six agent roles (proposers, PI, computational researcher, experimentalist, manager, reviewers) plus a safety agent operated an NV-centre diamond spin ensemble: over about 30 hours the PI rejected 75 proposals, accepting none in the first 17 batches until the manager excluded recurring idea families (52 of 56 earlier proposals) and 9 new proposals opened 7 new directions, after which the PI derived an exact calibration law showing that L²+1 calibrations are necessary and sufficient for sequences of up to L pulses (10 instead of the proposed bound of 91 for L=3). The first run passed all 10 precommitted accuracy criteria but failed global-phase and reference controls because of signal drift (+7.6% over the morning plus a 2.9% step when room lights were switched on), so the PI kept the verdict inconclusive and revised the protocol without relaxing the criteria; the final 6-hour run (21,600 one-second records) passed all criteria and controls, measuring a target contrast of (40.0±0.4)×10⁻³ against the law's predicted (39.7±1.3)×10⁻³ where interpolation rivals predicted zero, while humans built the apparatus and set the safety limits.

items.title: 分布式 AI 智能体：一个扰动一个智能体，32 分钟解读全脑 Perturb-seq 图谱 / Distributed AI Agents: One Agent per Perturbation Interprets a Whole-Brain Perturb-seq Atlas in 32 Minutes
items.summary: 给每个扰动分配一个智能体，可以在 32 分钟内解读整套全脑 Perturb-seq 筛选，文献支撑不会随工作量增加而变薄，盲评专家也更偏好这些报告而不是单智能体的解读。
items.content_html:
核心结论 给每个扰动分配一个智能体，可以在 32 分钟内解读整套全脑 Perturb-seq 筛选，文献支撑不会随工作量增加而变薄，盲评专家也更偏好这些报告而不是单智能体的解读。

问题背景 体内 Perturb-seq 筛选会产生成千上万个“扰动 × 细胞类型”的响应，结合机制与文献去解读它们受限于专家时间，而单个智能体面对大工作量时文献覆盖会下降。

核心机制与实证 团队并行运行 1,946 个 GPT-Rosalind-5.5 智能体，每个负责一个扰动，提供细胞类型分辨的 DEG 谱、工具和文献访问，但隐藏原始论文（模型知识截止 2025 年 12 月，论文 2026 年 3 月发布）；32 分钟内共阅读 39,185 篇论文、保留 16,445 条引用，在 55 个可直接检验的原研究结论中复现或细化了 48 个，并对 272 个留出扰动预测 DEG 数量。1,519 条高置信发现中 27.6% 与文献一致、41.9% 为推断、6.6% 与文献冲突、23.8% 无先例；在 20 对报告、每对三位专家的盲评中，分布式报告赢下 60 次判断中的 45 次（单智能体 10 次，平局 5 次），智能体与人类的新颖性评分相关（rho = 0.61），作者也指出仍需配对比较和独立数据集来验证其泛化性。

Takeaway Assigning one agent to each perturbation lets AI interpret a whole-brain Perturb-seq screen in 32 minutes with literature grounding that does not thin out as the workload grows, and blinded experts preferred these reports over a single agent's.

Problem In vivo Perturb-seq screens produce tens of thousands of perturbation-by-cell-type responses, interpreting them against mechanism and literature is limited by expert time, and a single agent's literature coverage drops as the workload grows.

How & Evidence The team ran 1,946 GPT-Rosalind-5.5 agents in parallel, one per perturbation, with cell-type-resolved DEG profiles, tools and literature access but the source manuscript withheld (model knowledge cutoff December 2025, manuscript released March 2026); in 32 minutes they made 39,185 paper reads and kept 16,445 citations, matched or refined 48 of 55 directly testable source-study findings, and were also asked to predict DEG counts for 272 held-out perturbations. Of 1,519 high-confidence findings, 27.6% agreed with literature, 41.9% were inferred, 6.6% disagreed and 23.8% had no precedent; across 20 matched report pairs each rated by three experts, distributed reports won 45 of 60 judgments (single agent 10, ties 5), agent and human novelty ratings correlated (rho = 0.61), and the authors say matched comparisons and independent datasets are still needed to show how far this generalizes.

items.title: FARMS：把数值数学教材变成保留适用条件的 Lean 陈述，每个目标约 1–2 美元 / FARMS: Turning Numerical-Math Textbooks Into Lean Statements That Keep Their Conditions, at About $1–2 per Target
items.summary: 把数值数学教材转成保留原始适用条件的 Lean 陈述，能以每个目标约 1–2 美元的成本给自动化科学智能体提供可检查的保证，因为每条形式化都要经过忠实性审查，而不只是能编译通过。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把数值数学教材转成保留原始适用条件的 Lean 陈述，能以每个目标约 1–2 美元的成本给自动化科学智能体提供可检查的保证，因为每条形式化都要经过忠实性审查，而不只是能编译通过。

问题背景 自动化计算科学需要 AI 能复用的数学保证，但只看编译是否通过的自动形式化会高估质量，还可能丢掉决定某个保证是否适用的前提（采样方式、边界条件、误差范数）。

核心机制与实证 FARMS 先为每个目标整理包含定义、假设和算法描述的源材料包，再借助可复用的领域表示做形式化，然后经过编译、语义审查和有限次修复；在随机数值线性代数与数值 PDE 的四个来源（Drineas–Mahoney、Halko–Martinsson–Tropp、Martinsson–Tropp、Larsson–Thomée）共 171 个目标中，157 个被流程接受，各来源平均估算成本为每个目标 0.85–2.29 美元。在随机抽取的 6 个目标上，FARMS 估算每个目标 2.84 美元，而作者对 AutoformBot 的陈述级改编版需 58.02 美元；Lean 检查过的蕴含关系把选定陈述连成计算技能，用于稳态热传导求解和波响应库压缩，不过目前只覆盖四个来源，发现新方法仍是开放问题。

Takeaway Turning numerical-math textbooks into Lean statements that keep their source conditions gives automated-science agents checkable guarantees for about $1–2 per target, because each formalization is reviewed for faithfulness rather than merely compiling.

Problem Automated computational science needs mathematical guarantees that AI can reuse, but autoformalization judged by compilation alone overstates quality and can drop the premises (sampling scheme, boundary conditions, error norm) that decide whether a guarantee applies.

How & Evidence FARMS first prepares a source package of definitions, assumptions and algorithm descriptions for each target, formalizes it with reusable domain representations, then runs compilation, semantic review and bounded repair; across 171 targets from four sources in randomized numerical linear algebra and numerical PDEs (Drineas–Mahoney, Halko–Martinsson–Tropp, Martinsson–Tropp, Larsson–Thomée), 157 were accepted by the pipeline at mean estimated costs of US$0.85–2.29 per target across sources. On six randomly selected targets FARMS cost an estimated US$2.84 per target against US$58.02 for the authors' statement-level adaptation of AutoformBot, and Lean-checked implications link selected statements into computational skills used in a steady heat-flow solve and wave-response library compression, though coverage is four sources and discovering new methods remains open.

items.title: Outerloop：autoresearch 系统报告的提升里有一截是运气，把测量搬到 agent 沙盒之外才算数 / Outerloop: Part of Every Autoresearch Gain Is Luck Until Measurement Moves Outside the Agent's Sandbox
items.summary: 让 agent 自己给自己的实验打分的 autoresearch 系统会系统性地夸大提升，因为它们从许多单种子的噪声运行里挑出最好的一次，报告的分数里就包含了那次的运气；而由内核在 agent 看不到的新种子上重新测量后，记入的提升与独立审计基本一致。
items.content_html:
核心结论 让 agent 自己给自己的实验打分的 autoresearch 系统会系统性地夸大提升，因为它们从许多单种子的噪声运行里挑出最好的一次，报告的分数里就包含了那次的运气；而由内核在 agent 看不到的新种子上重新测量后，记入的提升与独立审计基本一致。

问题背景 现有开源 autoresearch 系统（如 Karpathy 的 autoresearch、AIDE、ShinkaEvolve）里，agent 既写改动又评估改动，于是选择偏差、篡改评测代码、以及“分数是真的但改法不可接受”这三类问题都没人把关，而且搜索越大越容易出现。

核心机制与实证 Outerloop（纽约大学 Mengye Ren）像操作系统内核一样把 agent 当作不可信程序放进沙盒：只能改约定的文件，内核用自己抽取的隐藏种子背靠背测量基线和候选、超过噪声下限（这里 64 步，约 3%）才记功，再由两个只读评审 agent 检查作弊和改动归因，只有内核能推送；在 nanoGPT 训练提速基准、GLM 5.2、48 GPU 小时的对比中，ShinkaEvolve、AIDE、autoresearch 平均多报 83、45、45 步，而 Outerloop 为 −4，关掉内核测量让自家 agent 自报时也多报 36 步，120 个记功结果中 118 个（98%）被三种子审计确认。作者也指出，各系统用同一模型时最终分数相近，差距几乎都来自是否想起 Muon 优化器，所以这更多衡量的是“回忆已知技巧”而非新发现，验证约占研究 GPU 时间的五分之一，且只用了一个高噪声的小基准。

Takeaway Autoresearch systems that let agents grade their own experiments systematically overstate their gains, because they pick the best of many noisy single-seed runs and the reported number carries that run's luck, while a kernel that re-measures on seeds the agent never sees credits gains that match an independent audit.

Problem In current open autoresearch systems such as Karpathy's autoresearch, AIDE and ShinkaEvolve, the agent both writes and evaluates its changes, leaving selection bias, tampering with evaluation code and real-but-unacceptable gains unchecked, and larger searches make all three more likely.

How & Evidence Outerloop (Mengye Ren, NYU) runs agents as untrusted sandboxed programs like an operating-system kernel: they may edit only contracted files, the kernel measures base and candidate back to back on its own hidden seed and credits only gains above a noise floor (64 steps, about 3%), two read-only judge agents check for gaming and attribution, and only the kernel can push; on a nanoGPT training-speed benchmark with GLM 5.2 and 48 GPU-hours, ShinkaEvolve, AIDE and autoresearch over-claimed by 83, 45 and 45 steps on average versus −4 for Outerloop, its own agents over-claimed by 36 steps when the kernel measurement was switched off, and 118 of 120 credited results (98%) were confirmed by a three-seed audit. The authors note that with the same model the systems reach similar final scores and the difference comes almost entirely from recalling the Muon optimizer, so the benchmark measures recall of known tricks more than discovery, verification took about a fifth of the GPU-hours, and only one small, noisy benchmark was used.

items.title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness：用冻结模型比较 harness 会错杀更好的 harness / Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: Comparing Harnesses with a Frozen Model Rejects Better Ones
items.summary: 用同一个已训练好的模型给候选 harness 打分会系统性地错杀更好的 harness，因为后训练把模型的动作偏好绑死在训练时的 harness 上，换个 harness 时它先损失的“失配”在继续训练后大多能消掉，而新 harness 抬高的“上限”才是长期收益。
items.content_html:
核心结论 用同一个已训练好的模型给候选 harness 打分会系统性地错杀更好的 harness，因为后训练把模型的动作偏好绑死在训练时的 harness 上，换个 harness 时它先损失的“失配”在继续训练后大多能消掉，而新 harness 抬高的“上限”才是长期收益。

问题背景 自动 harness 设计通常用固定模型在每个候选 harness 下的表现来打分，这默认模型在旧 harness 下学到的东西能直接迁移到新 harness。

核心机制与实证 作者（香港科技大学（广州））在 KL 正则控制下证明部署回报恰好等于 harness 的上限减去策略的失配（沿自身轨迹累积的与最优策略的 KL），训练只改失配、换 harness 两者都改：在 MiniWoB++ 上用 Qwen3.5-2B 做实验，只是把观测 JSON 的字段顺序反过来、所有最优决策都不变，训练好的模型成功率就从 85.0% 掉到 19.2%；冻结比较否决、但抬高上限的 7 个 harness 换法在同等预算继续训练后全部超过原 agent，事先测得的“上限减失配”预测收益的 Spearman ρ=0.95（冻结回报变化只有 0.17）。在 5 个编码 agent harness（DeepAgents、Pi、DeepSeek Harness、Terminus-2、mini-SWE-agent）上，同一个冻结 Qwen3.5-9B 的 Terminal-Bench Lite 准确率在 47.9%–64.1% 之间，用更强的教师模型代替最优策略估计的“上限减失配”能把 5 个 harness 的顺序全部排对，而任一单项都会排错；不过机制实验都在小模型和可求解的小任务上。

Takeaway Scoring candidate harnesses with one already-trained model systematically rejects better harnesses, because post-training ties the model's action preferences to its training harness, so the mismatch it suffers after a switch mostly disappears with further training while the higher ceiling the new harness offers is the lasting gain.

Problem Automated harness design usually scores each candidate by how a fixed model performs under it, which assumes what the model learned under earlier harnesses carries over to the new one.

How & Evidence The authors (HKUST Guangzhou) prove under KL-regularized control that deployed return equals the harness's ceiling minus the policy's mismatch (its KL from the optimal policy accumulated along its own trajectories), so training moves only the mismatch while a harness change moves both: on MiniWoB++ with Qwen3.5-2B, just reversing the order of the observation JSON fields, which leaves every optimal decision unchanged, drops a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%, and all 7 harness swaps that a frozen comparison rejects but that raise the ceiling beat the original agent after equal further training, with ceiling minus mismatch measured beforehand predicting the gains at Spearman ρ=0.95 against 0.17 for the frozen return change. Across five coding-agent harnesses (DeepAgents, Pi, DeepSeek Harness, Terminus-2, mini-SWE-agent) a frozen Qwen3.5-9B ranges from 47.9% to 64.1% on Terminal-Bench Lite, and ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger teacher in place of the optimum orders all five correctly while either term alone misorders them, although the mechanism experiments use small models and small solvable tasks.

items.title: KARMA：只进化带编号的知识规则、不动代码，广告 agent 留出集提升 +8.96 分 / KARMA: Evolving Only Numbered Knowledge Rules, Not Code, Lifts Ad-Agent Hold-Out Scores by 8.96 Points
items.summary: 把 agent 的可改部分限制在六类带编号的知识规则上、每轮最多三条原子修改且验证集提升不足 1 分就整体回滚，同时让 Critic 对比成功和失败轨迹，能在不改权重和代码的情况下稳定提分，因为只看失败的修补容易把原本做对的决策也改坏，成功案例告诉它哪些规则该保留。
items.content_html:
核心结论 把 agent 的可改部分限制在六类带编号的知识规则上、每轮最多三条原子修改且验证集提升不足 1 分就整体回滚，同时让 Critic 对比成功和失败轨迹，能在不改权重和代码的情况下稳定提分，因为只看失败的修补容易把原本做对的决策也改坏，成功案例告诉它哪些规则该保留。

问题背景 工业广告 agent 的预算、出价和商品决策规则会随商品、流量和政策变化而过时，整段重写 prompt 难以追溯每处改动，大范围改 harness 代码又难以验证和回滚。

核心机制与实证 KARMA（阿里巴巴国际数字商业集团）用确定性的 Trace Verifier 把错误映射到候选知识模块，Critic 对比成败轨迹提出修改，受工具约束的 Evolver 写入带出处的原子编辑，在约 50 万条真实 AliExpress 运营日志抽样的 6 个领域、3 个模型家族（Qwen3.8-Max、GLM-5.3、Kimi-K3）共 18 种设置上把平均留出分从 30.19 提到 39.15（+8.96，+29.7%），16 种设置提升；去掉成功或失败任一证据都会让平均留出提升减半以上（+16.67 降到 +8.23 / +6.56），同一门控下也胜过 GEPA、AHE 和 Self-Harness。冻结后的知识跨领域迁移平均 +8.54 分，但汽车领域进化出的知识会拉低所有其他领域，Kimi-K3 在两个领域退步；评测是离线与历史操作的一致率，不代表收入等真实业务效果，每个主设置只跑一次。

Takeaway Restricting what an agent may change to six typed modules of numbered knowledge rules, allowing at most three atomic edits per round and rolling everything back when the validation gain is under one point, while a Critic compares successful and failed trajectories, reliably raises scores without touching weights or code, because repairs driven only by failures tend to break decisions that were already right and the successes show which rules to keep.

Problem Budget, bid and item rules for industrial advertising agents go stale as products, traffic and policies change, whole-prompt rewrites make individual changes hard to trace, and broad harness-code edits are hard to validate and roll back.

How & Evidence KARMA (Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group) uses a deterministic Trace Verifier to map errors to candidate knowledge modules, a Critic that contrasts successful and failed trajectories to propose changes, and a tool-constrained Evolver that writes atomic edits with provenance, raising the average hold-out score across 18 settings (6 domains sampled from about half a million real AliExpress operation logs × 3 model families: Qwen3.8-Max, GLM-5.3, Kimi-K3) from 30.19 to 39.15 (+8.96, +29.7%) and improving 16 of them; removing either successes or failures more than halves the average hold-out gain (+16.67 down to +8.23 or +6.56), and under the same gate it beats GEPA, AHE and Self-Harness. Frozen knowledge transfers across domains for an average +8.54, but knowledge evolved on Automotive lowers every other domain and Kimi-K3 regresses in two domains, and evaluation is offline agreement with logged actions rather than revenue, with each main setting run once.
